- Weapons: hatchet and cleaver (after Dear Uncle Tacitus), Mauser Pistol (after That's Murfree Country).
- Home robbery: Willard's Rest (page 181).

topics.title: Welcome to the New World
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Arthur wakes up on a Guarma beach.
Gold medal goals:
- Do not fall behind while walking with the chain gang
- Get 10 headshots
Walkthrough:
- Walk until you see a plume of smoke on your left and go to the campfire.
- Two short shootouts follow; fight both from your starting cover.
Tip: target enemies standing in the open for easier headshots.

topics.title: Savagery Unleashed
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Go to the stranger marker south of the river.
Gold medal goals:
- Release all the workers within four seconds
- Get eight headshots
- Finish within 5 minutes 40 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Rock left and right until you fall, then grapple your captor and beat him.
- Follow Leon through the ruins, staying in cover.
- At the far end, kill the lone guard and shoot the ropes the workers hang from, then turn and take cover as Fussar's men attack, including a sniper on the far wall.
Tip: shoot the three ropes in quick succession, then waste no time on the gunmen.

topics.title: A Kind and Benevolent Despot
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Find Dutch by the waterfall on the southeast side of Aguasdulces.
Gold medal goals:
- Get Javier to safety within two minutes
- Get 10 headshots
Walkthrough:
- Shimmy along the ledges with Dutch, follow Gloria through the caves, and lift the door when prompted.
- Outside, stealth-kill the right-hand guard of the first pair while Dutch takes the other; hide the bodies behind the well.
- In the sugar refinery, knife the left-hand guard of the next pair, then sabotage the three marked spots (valve, sugar sacks, shutters) and leave by the door behind Dutch.
- After rescuing Javier, protect him through the compound, switching cover based on the radar.
- Escape through the sugar fields, turning to shoot any red dots closing in behind.
- Across the river, hold off the guards from behind a rock. Snipers on the cliff can hit you in cover, so kill them first; you may need to aim manually through foliage.
Tip: once Javier is free, don't stop moving until the river.

topics.title: Hell Hath No Fury
topics.text:
Chapter 5.
Gold medal goals:
- Prevent four boats from reaching the shore
- Destroy the naval ship without missing a shot
- Finish with at least 70% accuracy
Walkthrough:
- On the roof, pick off Fussar's men on the beach and bridge (a tiny adjustment after locking on gives headshots), then help Hercule push the cannon.
- Grab the Double-Barreled Shotgun from the crate at the foot of the stairs for close fights on the way to the beach, then switch back to a Bolt Action Rifle or Carbine Repeater for range.
- At the end of the bridge, send your allies to the right, where boats tend to land first; focus fire there, then switch sides. Clear the remaining soldiers below and regroup.
- Back on the roof, man the cannon. Aim at the top of the ship to hit just above the waterline, and keep firing until it sinks.
Tip: headshots stop boats fastest, but chest shots work if cannon fire makes aiming hard. After stopping two, cross the bridge and check the map for the rest.

topics.title: Paradise Mercifully Departed
topics.text:
Chapter 5. The escape from Guarma.
Gold medal goals:
- Kill the first two sentries without being detected
- Escort the captain to the boat within 1 minute 45 seconds
- Get 25 headshots
- Complete within 6 minutes 45 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Run uphill; stealth-kill the first guard while Micah takes the other, and plant explosives on the cannon.
- Clear the ruins (watch the high points) and climb to the lookout platform for another shootout.
- Fight to the marked house in the workers' compound. In the standoff, wait until you can look down and kick a gun to the captain.
- When sent to the cannon, avoid the main alley, which the tower turret covers; go up the left side of the ruins over the walls. Blast the top of the tower.
- Push back to the ship cover to cover with quick headshots.
Tip: chain headshots and sprint everywhere; there's no time to stop.

topics.title: Dear Uncle Tacitus
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Back on the mainland at the Van Horn Trading Post pier. Steal the horse at the top of the steps and ride to Shady Belle.
Gold medal goals:
- Leave Shady Belle without being spotted by the Pinkertons
- Finish within eight minutes
Walkthrough:
- Pick up the letter on the living room table.
- Crouch, let a Pinkerton pass through the doorway and knife him from behind. Another is examining the fireplace next door: kill him or just leave through the door.
- Mount up and ride to Lakay.
Tip: you don't need to kill anyone. Sneak behind the first Pinkerton straight to the entrance and gallop off.
Unlocks the hatchet and cleaver.

topics.title: Fleeting Joy
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Pinkertons attack the gang's new camp at Lakay.
Gold medal goals:
- Kill two Pinkertons during the Dead Eye ambush
- Get at least 70% accuracy with the Gatling gun
- Get five headshots with the Gatling gun
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Follow Sadie to the other house, climb through the trapdoor and take cover at the entrance.
- Tag several heads in the automatic Dead Eye, then sprint to cover and headshot the rest.
- When offered, run to the Gatling gun (marked yellow on the radar) and mow down the Pinkertons and their reinforcements. Shooting the red crates causes big explosions. It ends when they flee.
Tip: fire the Gatling gun in short bursts, like a semi-automatic rifle.

topics.title: That's Murfree Country
topics.text:
Chapter 5. Talk to Dutch at the Lakay camp, then ride with Charles. Bring a strong close-range weapon such as a shotgun.
Gold medal goals:
- Get 15 headshots
- Deliver Meredith to her mother within two minutes
- Finish with at least 85% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Ride your horse rather than taking Charles's canoe offer, so you keep access to your saddle.
- At the two Murfrees, take the left one with a silent weapon such as a throwing knife; Charles gets the other.
- Then choose: sneak into the cave, or flush them out with dynamite.
- Stealth: cut the throat of the entrance sentry, take the next one inside quietly (or let Charles), then drop from the ledge on your right onto two more. The next kill raises the alarm.
- Dynamite: throw it at the Murfree by the cave mouth, then take cover from a big counterattack before pushing in.
- In the cave, kill charging melee Murfrees first, since one hit can kill you. Keep your distance and hold chokepoints. Free the girl from the cage.
- Take Meredith back to Annesburg. Accepting or refusing her mother's money has no honor effect.
Tip: melee kills don't count as headshots, so use guns and Dead Eye. Cut through the woods on the first part of the ride.

topics.title: Chapter 6: Beaver Hollow (overview)
topics.text:
After escaping Guarma and being driven out of Lakay by the Pinkertons, what's left of the gang settles at Beaver Hollow.
- Missions: A Fork in the Road and Icarus and Friends (if not done in Chapter 5); Visiting Hours; Just a Social Call; Do Not Seek Absolution I & II; Of Men and Angels; The Course of True Love IV & V; Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII; The Delights of Van Horn; The Bridge to Nowhere; A Rage Unleashed; Archeology for Beginners; Honor, Amongst Thieves; The Fine Art of Conversation; Goodbye, Dear Friend; Favored Sons; The King's Son; Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow I & II; My Last Boy; Our Best Selves; Red Dead Redemption.
- Conditional: Do Not Seek Absolution needs high honor. Of Men and Angels needs Brothers and Sisters, One and All done in Chapter 4. Archeology for Beginners only opens if you agree to help Rains Fall in A Rage Unleashed, and Honor, Amongst Thieves only if you agree to help Monroe in Archeology. Skipping either adds a six-hour delay. Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow Part II becomes compulsory if you agree to help Sadie.
- Time-sensitive: The Course of True Love V, Do Not Seek Absolution I & II, Of Men and Angels, Money Lending VI & VII. Our Best Selves is the last chance for most of them, and the guide calls it a point of no return.
- Loansharking: J. John Weathers, Arthur Londonderry.
- Weapons: Carcano Rifle, Litchfield Repeater.

topics.title: A Fork in the Road
topics.text:
Triggers automatically as you approach Sadie's marker in Saint Denis to start Icarus and Friends (Chapter 5 or 6). It's mostly cinematic and best left unspoiled.
Gold medal: complete it within 3 minutes 5 seconds.
Afterwards your attribute cores drain a little faster than before. This is intended; see page 166.

topics.title: Icarus and Friends
topics.text:
Chapter 5 or 6. Meet Sadie in Saint Denis and follow her to the outskirts of the city.
Gold medal goals:
- Keep the balloon at the correct altitude for the entire journey
- Get five headshots from the balloon
- Finish with at least 70% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- The Ascend prompt shows your altitude. A faded yellow segment marks the right height, and the gauge turns yellow when you're in it. Tap the button now and then to stay inside; the zone moves lower as you near the prison, since you need to drop down to look closely.
- Hover over the penitentiary and use binoculars to check groups of prisoners for John. Climb away when the guards open fire.
- Snipe the O'Driscolls chasing Sadie below once your reticle turns red.
- Flying alone, climb over the bridge, then drop so Sadie can grab the rope, and pull her up.
- Final shootout: hold your first cover, then turn and move to cover on the other side when reinforcements arrive from behind.
Tip: the last fight is brutal, so stay in cover and make every shot count.

topics.title: Visiting Hours
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Find Sadie on a pier northwest of Sisika Penitentiary.
Gold medal goals:
- Get headshots on both prison guards when sniping from the tower
- Escape to the boat within 2 minutes 45 seconds
- Finish within nine minutes
- Finish with at least 80% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Row to the island, crouch and follow Sadie to the watchtower, climb up and stealth-kill the guard.
- Use the Rolling Block Rifle's scope on the group in front of the barn to your right, headshot the two guards, then run there.
- After the cutscene, march your hostage to the prison entrance. When shooting starts, sprint back across the bridge and take cover behind the crates or barrels; it's a bottleneck and harder for wall snipers to reach.
- Cover Sadie and John across the field, stopping briefly at the crates and cotton bales at the end, then join them in the shallows.
- No cover on the boat: use lock-on-and-flick headshots.
- Ride with your friends to Beaver Hollow.
Tip: speed matters most; only shoot what's directly threatening you.

topics.title: Just a Social Call
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Meet Micah between two small wooden houses in Annesburg; follow him and Dutch and take cover behind the marked crate.
Gold medal goals:
- After killing Cornwall, reach the horses within 2 minutes 45 seconds
- Headshot three mounted enemies
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Shoot the men on the boat from your first spot, then turn to a crate facing the Pinkerton reinforcements.
- Keep up with Dutch through the coal mining facility (go up the stairs if you lose him). Don't linger on the stairs by the coal conveyor, where you're exposed from every side.
- At the top, shoot the oil wagon to take out at least two of the last guards, then free the horses in the marked area.
- On the escape, take your hand off the steering stick for a few seconds (your horse keeps its pace), lock on and headshot riders, then steer again.
Tip: you need fast, reliable headshots to make the deadline.

topics.title: Do Not Seek Absolution I & II
topics.text:
Chapter 6, time-sensitive. Only available with high honor (at least rank 4): Edith Downes is by the coal mining facility in Annesburg.
Gold medal goals (Part I):
- Finish within 1 minute 20 seconds
Gold medal goals (Part II):
- Find Edith Downes within 1 minute 10 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Part I: go to the mine at the top of the hill and beat the foreman who's bullying her son Archie. Gallop there and block-and-counter for speed.
- Part II: four hours later, meet Archie in a small alley off Annesburg's main street, next to the newspaper seller. Follow the railway to the marked area northeast of town and use Eagle Eye to find a trail on the path under the bridge, heading northwest. It leads to a hitched horse and Edith just beyond. Persuade her to come back (ask or demand, same result) and take her to Archie.
Tip: for Part II, go straight to the area without stopping to examine anything at the bridge.

topics.title: Of Men and Angels
topics.text:
Chapter 6, time-sensitive. Only available if you completed Brothers and Sisters, One and All.
- Greet Sister Calderón outside her church in Saint Denis. She asks for donations for the poor: give any four food items, or 10 dollars, or a mix of money and food worth the same.

topics.title: The Course of True Love IV & V
topics.text:
Chapter 6, time-sensitive. Read Penelope's letter in your tent. She waits outside the small cabin facing the gazebo where you first met her.
Gold medal goals:
- Headshot five of the Braithwaites as they pursue the train
- Finish within 7 minutes 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Ride with Penelope to Rhodes station and buy the couple's tickets.
- Beau's cousins attack: block and counter in the fistfight, then board the train.
- When the train is attacked, go to the rear flatbed, take cover and headshot the riders.
- Drive the train to Riggs Station from the engine.
Tip: you can jump on the train before the fistfight ends to save time; Dead Eye helps with headshots while moving.

topics.title: Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII
topics.text:
Chapter 6, time-sensitive. Strauss gives you two new debtors.
- John Weathers: near Moonstone Pond to the west, fixing his broken wagon. Soldiers looking for him attack; fight from cover, then push to the rocks. Then choose: forgive the debt (+10 honor, no reward) or collect (a silver locket, -5 honor).
- Arthur Londonderry: ask the guard at the entrance to Annesburg's mine, go into the pit and talk to the foreman. Then visit the debtor's widow outside a cabin at Butcher's Creek, a short ride south. Arthur forgives her automatically, and giving her a small sum of money as well earns +20 honor.
- Return to camp to confront Strauss.

topics.title: The Delights of Van Horn
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Meet Micah just west of the Van Horn Trading Post, then ride with Bill to the ambush spot.
Gold medal goals:
- Headshot five soldiers with a long scoped rifle
- Finish with at least 85% accuracy
Walkthrough:
- Go upstairs in the derelict house and snipe the wagon guards from a window, then go down and join Bill on the wagon.
- On the ride back, kill pursuers before they hit the wagon too much: enough bullets set off the dynamite and kill you instantly. Prioritize riders near the back; use Dead Eye on erratic riders.
- It ends when you reach Micah, whoever is driving.
Tip: a sniper rifle with a long scope helps; use Dead Eye and tonics for moving targets.

topics.title: The Bridge to Nowhere
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Find John at Bacchus Station.
Gold medal goals:
- Plant the dynamite within 1 minute 35 seconds
- Escape the oncoming train within 19 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Pump the hand car by holding the button on Arthur's turn and releasing on John's.
- Lower the two dynamite crates to John on the level below by alternating the two triggers until he grabs them.
- Down the ladder, plant dynamite on the bridge's three pillars, collecting a charge from the foot of the ladder for each.
- Sprint back to the hand car and pump away from the train, then push the plunger.
Tip: memorize where each pillar is; every second counts.

topics.title: A Rage Unleashed
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Speak to Reverend Swanson at camp, then follow Dutch and Eagle Flies to the beach.
Gold medal goals:
- Knock out two soldiers on the boat
- Round up the horses and reach the shore within 1 minute 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Paddle the canoe to the boat, tapping in time with the paddle.
- On deck, knock out the man in front of you and then the one who walks out from the horse stalls. Three more are playing cards at the bow: sneak up and knock out the nearest, then beat the other two, or just shoot once the medal goal is done. Plant dynamite on the anchor.
- Swim to the three horses, mount one and head for shore; the others follow.
- Choice: helping Rains Fall unlocks Archeology for Beginners. Refusing means you miss it and Honor, Amongst Thieves.

topics.title: Archeology for Beginners
topics.text:
Chapter 6 (only if you agreed to help Rains Fall). Find Rains Fall in the tent by the campfire at the Wapiti Indian Reservation and follow him to a sacred site.
Gold medal goals:
- Recover the relics without being detected
- Recover the relics within 1 minute 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- On the way Monroe asks for help: accepting unlocks Honor, Amongst Thieves; refusing loses it.
- Rains Fall stops for herbs. It gets cold higher up, so switch to a warmer outfit from the horse wheel.
- Use Eagle Eye on the clues at the site.
- Go down to the army camp. The Chanupa and other sacred items lie in the middle of camp by the cooking pot. Wait for the patrolling guard to circle to the far side, sneak in, take them, and slip out.
- Return to Rains Fall. If you killed no guards, he gives you the Owl Feather trinket, which permanently slows core drain by 15%.
Tip: gallop down, dismount just short of the camp, crouch straight to the relics, then gallop back.

topics.title: Honor, Amongst Thieves
topics.text:
Chapter 6 (only if you agreed to help Monroe). Speak to Monroe at the Wapiti Indian Reservation and follow him.
Gold medal goals:
- Recover the vaccine without being detected
- Finish within five minutes
Walkthrough:
- When the wagon comes, ride alongside it out of sight behind the two drivers, match speed, and jump aboard when prompted.
- Search the crates for the medicine and take it back to Monroe.
- This only works before the wagon reaches Cornwall Kerosene & Tar; after that, a shootout is unavoidable.

topics.title: The Fine Art of Conversation
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Trelawny sits near your tent at camp. Then ride with Charles and Rains Fall to the meeting.
Gold medal goals:
- Kill a pursuer's horse during the escape
- Finish within 9 minutes 30 seconds
- Finish with at least 75% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- After the meeting, back toward your horse, mount up and gallop with the others, shooting pursuers behind you without breaking stride.
- Join Monroe in the forest on foot for a long fight among rocks and trees.
- Mount up and escape with Charles, killing the last riders before the train station.
Tip: no headshot goal here; aim at torsos with a strong weapon and ammo.

topics.title: Goodbye, Dear Friend
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Meet Sadie and Dutch in the Saint Denis saloon and follow them to the gallows.
Gold medal goals:
- Find Cairn's backup within 45 seconds
- Get eight headshots with the scoped rifle
- Finish within 6 minutes 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Two ways to the roof: through the arches ahead, up the stairs to the top floor and the ladder at the end of the balcony; or up the ladder on your left, right into the house, upstairs and out of a window.
- An O'Driscoll jumps you on the roof: mash free, then grapple and stab him.
- In the shootout, enemies wear gray hats. Protect Dutch and Sadie; watch where Dutch is shooting to find targets.
Tip: the route through the arches is fastest because you can run all the way. Brief Dead Eye helps with the scoped headshots.

topics.title: Favored Sons
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Dutch and Eagle Flies wait on the cliff top in Cumberland Forest.
Gold medal goals:
- Kill the soldier on the cannon within 45 seconds
- Get 35 headshots
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Wire the spool to dynamite at all four marked spots, run back up and detonate once every soldier is past the first charge.
- Headshot the soldiers below, then those climbing toward you.
- After looting, a new wave attacks from the opposite hill with a cannon. Go up the left side of the hill (fewer enemies) to kill the gunner.
- Ride away with Dutch under cannon fire; in the canyon, clear the cliff soldiers and keep following him.
- On the narrow path, beat back the first wave from behind, then flee when Dutch says. At the cutscene, surrender, then slowly back up and jump off the cliff. Swim left in the rapids to grab Dutch's hand.
Tip: enemies keep respawning in the cannon section, so you can rack up the 35 headshots there.

topics.title: The King's Son
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Speak to Charles at the Wapiti Indian Reservation, then Rains Fall in his tent, and ride with Charles to Fort Wallace.
Gold medal goals:
- While infiltrating Fort Wallace, headshot every soldier blocking your way to Eagle Flies
- Kill 15 enemies while escaping in the canoe
- Finish with at least 80% accuracy
Walkthrough:
- The infiltration fails if you're spotted, so equip the bow. Headshot one of the two entrance guards (Charles gets the other), hug the wall to avoid the sentry above, and work through the pairs and lone soldiers with Charles.
- Behind the crates, climb the ladder, kill the lone sentry and shoot an arrow at the lantern. As the fire spreads, go down to the cells with Charles, take the keys from the guard and free Eagle Flies.
- Fight outside cover to cover; at the blocked door, turn the nearby cannon and blast it open.
- Gallop away with Charles, turning the camera to shoot close pursuers, and clear the last soldiers before the canoe.
- On the river, stop paddling to shoot whenever a red dot appears (including on the rope bridge above), and head ashore when the current slows.
Tip: take the lead in the stealth part and use Dead Eye on pairs so Charles doesn't steal kills.

topics.title: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow I & II
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Sadie is throwing knives at a tree in camp and asks for help. Say yes to continue; refusing loses the mission for good. Ride with her now or meet her at Hanging Dog Ranch.
Gold medal goals:
- Headshot the sniper in the barn
- Secure the barn without taking any damage
- Finish within 5 minutes 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- A short, intense fight with enemies from every side. Stay in cover, fire in bursts and watch for flankers on the radar. Headshot the sniper at the barn's upstairs window as soon as he appears.
- To secure the barn, take cover behind the wooden post on the left just inside the door and let them come to you, including any upstairs. Then join Sadie in the cabin.
Tip: push aggressively cover to cover and expose yourself only briefly.

topics.title: My Last Boy
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Meet Dutch and Micah at camp and ride out with the group to the oilfields.
Gold medal goals:
- Save Paytah
- Get 30 headshots
- Finish with at least 80% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- On foot, get to cover and shoot the snipers on the tower first.
- On the wooden walkways, run to the nearby building and headshot the soldier who bursts out to kill Eagle Flies.
- Soldiers then come from all sides; clear, move, repeat, watching the radar for flankers. In the final stretch by the train, shoot the soldier wrestling an ally on the half-built house's terrace. When the Gatling gun opens up, take cover and aim just above its muzzle flash.
- Circle the factory to regroup, then follow Dutch to search the upstairs office. Hold the bottom of the stairs on the way out.
- In the automatic Dead Eye after the cutscene you don't aim; just fire when the reticle lines up.
- Ride back to the Wapiti Indian Reservation.

topics.title: Our Best Selves
topics.text:
Chapter 6. Point of no return: your last chance for several time-sensitive side stories (check the page 94 flowchart). It plays back-to-back with the next two missions; free roam returns after them.
Gold medal goals:
- Get a headshot in Dead Eye after jumping from Dutch's horse
- Finish within 11 minutes
- Fight through the train with at least 80% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Talk to Dutch in his tent, ride out, collect the dynamite with John and meet the others outside Saint Denis.
- When the train skips the station, chase it and jump aboard.
- Fight toward the engine; for the dual-wielding enemy, wait in cover until he reloads, then headshot him.
- When the car ahead catches fire, jump from the train onto Dutch's horse beside John, then back onto the next flatbed. Use the automatic Dead Eye for a clean headshot on the soldier.
- Man the Gatling gun against riders from all sides (ammo is unlimited and accuracy doesn't count here).
- Blow the armored car's door with dynamite (or shoot it from a distance), loot it, and jump off before the train reaches the bridge you destroyed earlier.

topics.title: Red Dead Redemption
topics.text:
Chapter 6's finale. Follow Sadie to Van Horn.
Gold medal goals:
- Get seven headshots while covering Sadie from the lighthouse
- After Sadie is captured, reach Abigail and Sadie within one minute
- Finish with at least 70% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Climb the lighthouse (ladder, stairs, second ladder) and cover Sadie with your sniper rifle. Start by shooting one of the two men a few steps to her right. Follow her shots and gun smoke to spot attackers, and watch for balcony snipers.
- Back on the street, clear enemies from cover and fight to the pier.
- In the marked building, tag both heads in the automatic Dead Eye, then mash the prompt.
- Escape on horseback with Dead Eye, stop at Butcher's Creek, and ride on to find Dutch.
- At Beaver Hollow, hold off the Pinkertons, then follow John through the cave and up the shaft. Focus on riding rather than shooting during the escape, then clear the Pinkertons on the hilltop.
- Big choice: go back for the money (lose honor) or help John get away (gain honor). The walkthrough gives this as 10 points; the honor table on page 170 lists it as a whole rank. It also decides which of two finales you get.
- Money: return to the cave with limited gear, push only through enemies in your way, take the chest and get out. Helping John: follow him up the cliffs and hold off Pinkertons until Micah arrives.
- Against Micah in melee, let him attack, block, counter once, and repeat.
Tip: sprint straight to Sadie and Abigail, ignoring anyone not in your way.

topics.title: Epilogue Part 1: Pronghorn Ranch (overview)
topics.text:
John, Abigail and Jack try to start over working at Pronghorn Ranch.
- Missions: The Wheel; Simple Pleasures; Farming, for Beginners; Fatherhood, for Beginners; Old Habits; Jim Milton Rides, Again?; Fatherhood, for Idiots; Motherhood; Gainful Employment (end of Part 1 or start of Part 2); The Landowning Classes & Home of the Gentry?
- Strangers: A Better World, A New Friend (page 212), The American Inferno, Burnt Out (page 191).
- Bounties: Esteban Cortez, Joaquin Arroyo (page 185).

topics.title: The Wheel
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Starts automatically after the previous mission: drive the wagon to Strawberry.
Gold medal goals:
- Reach Pronghorn without dropping any supplies
- Reclaim the wagon within one minute
Walkthrough:
- Stop just before the bridge, talk to the general store owner, then meet Abigail at the doctor's across the river. Drive the wagon to Pronghorn Ranch.
- When Laramie outlaws steal the wagon, take the horse in front of you and chase it. Stop it by cutting in front or jumping aboard, then drive it back.
Tip: the hard goal is not dropping supplies. Drive slowly and ease off for every bump and hazard.

topics.title: Simple Pleasures
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Speak to Mr Geddes and follow Abe around the ranch to the cow.
Gold medal goals:
- While milking, fill a bucket within 10 seconds
- Finish within 5 minutes 15 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Milk by pulling each stick down in turn, in a steady rhythm.
- Pick up the pitchfork, scoop manure from the stalls and dump it in the wheelbarrow. Put the fork back and talk to Abigail at the house.

topics.title: Farming, for Beginners
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Find Tom Dickens at the south edge of the ranch.
Gold medal goals:
- Fix the first section of fence within 1 minute 30 seconds
- Avoid being hit by the bull
Walkthrough:
- Pound the post in, set each rail to the right height and slot it into the notches.
- In the corral, lasso the bull. It fights the first attempts and charges, so get somewhere it can't reach (outrunning it won't work). Keep trying, then calm it and walk up slowly, reassuring it at each prompt, while holding the lasso.

topics.title: Fatherhood, for Beginners
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Find David Geddes at the back of the farm; Abe takes you to his son Duncan and the nervous horse Jeremiah.
Gold medal goals:
- Tire out Jeremiah within 45 seconds
- Feed Jeremiah a treat
- Teach Jack to ride without his horse bucking him off
- Win the race back to Pronghorn Ranch
Walkthrough:
- Calm Jeremiah, mount him and gallop in the fields until his stamina is gone (jumping drains it fast), then ride into Duncan's corral.
- Help Mrs Geddes foal a mare: rotate the stick until the vibration peaks to find the legs, then pull.
- Teach Jack to ride, adjusting his pace. Don't go faster than a canter or he may fall. At the stream, race him back to the ranch.
Tip: feed Jeremiah a treat after calming him in the stable but before entering the corral.

topics.title: Old Habits
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Starts automatically once the two previous missions are done: investigate a disturbance and beat the Laramie responsible in a fistfight.
Gold medal goals:
- Defeat the Laramie without taking a hit
- Defeat the Laramie within 25 seconds
Tip: let him swing first, block, then counter hard.

topics.title: Jim Milton Rides, Again?
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. David Geddes and his wife are at the stable entrance.
Gold medal goals:
- Get 10 kills while dual-wielding sidearms
- Get 15 headshots
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Beat the two thugs attacking Tom Dickens in the stalls (two at once, so block and counter carefully), grab your weapons and ride to Hanging Dog Ranch.
- Whatever you say, a big shootout starts. Get to cover fast; watch for snipers on the tower and the barn's upper floor.
- With the ranch clear, mash free from the last man in the barn, beat him and finish him. Return to Pronghorn.
Tip: use cover close to enemies to make the most of dual sidearms.

topics.title: Fatherhood, for Idiots
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Meet Abigail at your house and drive the wagon to Strawberry with Jack.
Gold medal goals:
- Kill all three enemies in Dead Eye
- After the confrontation, return to Pronghorn Ranch within 1 minute 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Park near the post office and collect your mail.
- Three men ambush you; a fight is unavoidable, but talking buys time to drink a Dead Eye tonic. Draw, trigger Dead Eye, tag all three heads and fire.
- Drive back to Pronghorn, cutting every corner, especially the early hairpin.

topics.title: Motherhood
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Starts automatically after Fatherhood, for Idiots. Follow Abe, greet the clerk for a telegram and go to the cabin, then do any one of the chores you've learned and head to the Geddes house.
Gold medal goals:
- Finish within 1 minute 30 seconds
Tip: run everywhere and pick cow-milking.

topics.title: Gainful Employment
topics.text:
End of Epilogue 1 or start of Epilogue 2. Meet Sadie in the Valentine saloon and ride with her.
Gold medal goals:
- After arriving in Strawberry, locate the bounty within 30 seconds
- After mounting your horse, catch and hogtie the bounty within 1 minute 15 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Ask around Strawberry for Nathan Kirk. The owner of the Welcome Center hotel says he's in room three upstairs. He jumps out of the window: follow, mount up and chase.
- He must be taken alive, so keep your guns holstered. Use the red radar icon to cut corners (turn right leaving the small ravine) and get around the sheep he scatters.
- Lasso, hogtie and put him on Sadie's horse.
Tip: run straight to the Welcome Center.

topics.title: The Landowning Classes & Home of the Gentry?
topics.text:
Epilogue 1. Ansel Atherton waits in his office at the Blackwater bank.
Gold medal goals:
- Finish within 2 minutes 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Ride west to Beecher's Hope to deal with the squatters: pay them 10 dollars to leave (gains honor) or kill them (Dead Eye drops them before they draw).
- After the bank cutscene, return to Beecher's Hope with Uncle.
Tip: ride straight to Beecher's Hope from the bank, ignoring the suggested route.

topics.title: Epilogue Part 2: Beecher's Hope (overview)
topics.text:
To win back Abigail, John buys a plot of land west of Blackwater: Beecher's Hope.
- Missions: Bare Knuckle Friendships; An Honest Day's Labors; Home Improvement for Beginners; The Tool Box; A New Jerusalem; A Quick Favor for an Old Friend; Uncle's Bad Day (followed automatically by The Best of Women); Trying Again; A Really Big Bastard; A New Future Imagined; American Venom.
- Special character: the Chelonian Master (page 231).

topics.title: Bare Knuckle Friendships
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Speak to Uncle at Beecher's Hope, then find Charles in Saint Denis.
Gold medal goals:
- After arriving in Saint Denis, find Charles within 1 minute 50 seconds
- Kill all of Guido Martelli's men within 10 seconds
Walkthrough:
- The saloon bartender or the local fence sends you to Saint Saturnines, just north.
- Bet on Charles for easy money, then follow him after the fight.
- In the dock ambush, headshot the four attackers from your first cover (Dead Eye makes it quick), then board the wagon.
- Keep a low profile while Charles drives you out of the city.
Tip: gallop to the saloon, ask the bartender, and ride straight to Saint Saturnines.

topics.title: An Honest Day's Labors
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Meet Sadie in the Blackwater saloon and ride with her to a hill above Armadillo; scout with binoculars.
Gold medal goals:
- After choosing your approach, escape with Shane Finley within five minutes
- Kill all of Langton's men during the horseback escape
- Finish with at least 70% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Choose an approach. All three end in a big fight:
- Sneak: with Sadie, throwing-knife the first pair, let her take the man by the bridge, then knife a fourth from the bridge before the alarm.
- Shoot from the hill: a free first kill and several easy snipes before you head down.
- Threaten: same as shooting, but without surprise.
- The canyon has little cover and many enemies. Advance slowly and kill the ridgeline snipers first. Reinforcements, some mounted, come from below; don't let them flank you.
- Load the bounty on a horse. Riders and snipers ambush the exit. For gold, ride slowly and kill them all rather than galloping through.
- Deliver him to the cell at the Blackwater sheriff's office.
Tip: for the five-minute goal, attack head-on and sprint down the slope cover to cover with quick headshots.

topics.title: Home Improvement for Beginners
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Speak to Uncle by the campfire at Beecher's Hope. After the cutscene, lean back and tap repeatedly to pull the reins.
Gold medal goals:
- Finish within 18 seconds
Tip: start pulling hard the moment the cutscene ends.

topics.title: The Tool Box
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Find Albert Cakes at the Blackwater lumberyard, then follow Charles to Manzanita Post.
Gold medal goals:
- Headshot all Skinner Brothers hiding up in the trees
- Find Mr Wayne within 2 minutes 15 seconds
- Complete the mission using only sidearms
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- On the way back, Skinners ambush you. Fight from your first cover, then the wagon on the right. Machete wielders can kill instantly up close: headshot them on approach, hip-fire if they're too close, and mash if grabbed.
- One steals your tool box. At the clearing, take cover behind the uprooted tree and kill the two hiding in trees.
- Clear the rest (machetes first), then pick up the tool box by Mr Wayne's body in the marked area and drive home.
Tip: the Mr Wayne timer starts when the box is stolen; dual-wield and use the lock-on-and-flick technique.

topics.title: A New Jerusalem
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Talk to Uncle at Beecher's Hope; best experienced unspoiled.
Gold medal goals:
- Hammer the nails in with at least 80% accuracy
- Finish within 3 minutes 35 seconds
Tip: press the button in time with the character's arm swings, as if starting each hammer blow; after a few cycles it clicks. Watch for other prompts.

topics.title: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Uncle is asleep under a tree; follow him to Blackwater.
Gold medal goals:
- Force Cortez's men to flee from Rhodes within 30 seconds
- Get four hip fire kills
- Get five headshots while covering Sadie with a long scoped rifle
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Talk to Albert Cakes at the lumberyard, then ride with Sadie to Painted Sky. Searching the barn starts a fistfight with Ramon Cortez (block, counter).
- In Rhodes, drop him in the sheriff's cell. When the shootout starts, Dead Eye the bunched men from the doorway, then clear the street and ride with Sadie.
- At Dewberry Creek, snipe for Sadie; trace her shots to find distant attackers.
- Join her under the railway bridge, fight to the beach and clear the last enemies behind the rocks.
- Aim at Cortez's boat to make him turn back, beat the final wave, and take Cortez to the Rhodes sheriff.
Tip: barge in, Dead Eye several, then hip-fire four more for both early goals.

topics.title: Uncle's Bad Day
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Talk to Uncle outside the new barn at Beecher's Hope, then follow Charles to Tall Trees. Followed automatically by The Best of Women.
Gold medal goals:
- Get five headshots using the bow
- After freeing Uncle, return to Beecher's Hope within 3 minutes 10 seconds
- Finish with at least 80% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Leave your horse at the marked spot. Bow one of the two lookouts (Charles takes the other). You can bow the three-man patrol or let it pass, then arrow the wagon driver when he stops to check the body he's dragging.
- Climb the marked boulder and use binoculars to find Uncle by the campfire.
- Fight into the camp from the nearest tent, clear it and cut Uncle free.
- In the automatic Dead Eye you don't aim; fire when the reticle is on the Skinner attacking Charles.
- Escort Charles (carrying Uncle) a few steps ahead, headshotting threats, especially machete wielders, until you reach the horses and ride home.
Tip: bow headshots on one lookout, the patrol of three and the driver give you five.

topics.title: Trying Again
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Jack is reading under a tree outside the house; walk with him to the river.
Gold medal goals:
- Catch a fish
- Finish within 5 minutes 20 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Catch a fish at the spot. When Jack worries about Rufus, put the rod away and search the marked area east of the path, then run back when Jack calls and suck the venom from the wound.
Tip: hold the button to walk faster to the river.

topics.title: A Really Big Bastard
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Abigail is in the house at Beecher's Hope; then follow Sadie into Tall Trees.
Gold medal goals:
- Shoot the bear four times as it charges
- Headshot both rival bounty hunters in Dead Eye
- Finish within 7 minutes 15 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Fire at the charging bear during the automatic Dead Eye (it won't die) and mash free in the struggle.
- After Sadie's stop at a small campsite, track the bounty with Eagle Eye when she loses the trail, to a small cabin.
- Escorting him to the Blackwater sheriff, two riders stop to talk to Sadie. They'll attack regardless, so shoot first with Dead Eye headshots.
Tip: don't dismount at the campsite; ride on toward the cabin. Refill Dead Eye with a tonic after the bear.

topics.title: A New Future Imagined
topics.text:
Epilogue 2. Abigail waits at the house; drive the wagon to Blackwater.
Gold medal goals:
- Finish within 7 minutes 30 seconds
Walkthrough:
- Park at the marked spot, choose a backdrop at the photo studio and pose.
- Take Abigail to the Imperial Theatre across the street.
- Row out on the lake from the shore nearby and follow the prompts.
Tip: gallop, walk and row straight to each stop.

topics.title: American Venom
topics.text:
The final mission. Join Abigail in the living room, then follow Sadie to Strawberry.
Gold medal goals:
- Help Sadie catch Cleet within 35 seconds
- Headshot the sniper who shoots Charles
- Finish with at least 85% accuracy
- Complete the mission without consuming any health items
Walkthrough:
- Cross the bridge as soon as you arrive to find Cleet and chase him.
- Beat him, drag him to the gallows and put the noose on. Hanging or sparing him is your call; sparing earns honor. Ride toward Mount Hagen.
- When Charles is shot, sprint behind the rock ahead and kill the sniper, either with a scoped rifle from there or by closing in cover to cover. Dead Eye helps with the headshot.
- Fight up the mountain, sniper-first. Keep your health core topped up. After a narrow rocky section, turn and take cover: enemies hit you from behind and on the cliff. Three thugs appear on a coverless hilltop; chain headshots or use Dead Eye. Clear the second campsite and the four marked zones.
- Micah, outside a mountain hut, is too quick to beat in a straight duel. Shoot the lantern above his cover to set it alight and force him to the wood shed, keep firing between his volleys, and when he moves behind the outhouse, you've won.
- What follows is best left unspoiled.

topics.title: After the credits: post-story play
topics.text: After the closing credits you resume play at Beecher's Hope. Everything else stays open: stranger missions, bounty hunting, robberies, challenges and more. The Exploration chapter (from page 134) covers them all, along with total completion.

sections.title: Missions
sections.intro: Every story mission from Colter to the final Epilogue, with who starts it, where, what you do, the hidden gold medal goals, and tips for earning them.

topics.title: Getting horses, rare wild horses and horse categories
topics.text:
Three ways to get a horse: tame a wild one, take an ambient one (hitched horses in town, or cut one loose from a wagon; mind the witnesses), or buy one at a stable. A horse only becomes your main mount when you put your saddle on it (unlocked after Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego).
- Breaking a wild horse: approach locked on, lasso it or walk very slowly while calming it, then mount to start a rodeo. Lean against its bucking, ride a while and pat it; it becomes a temporary horse until you saddle it. The map on page 134 shows wild breed habitats in general terms.
- Three very rare wild horses: the white Arabian and the tiger-striped bay Mustang (both shown on the habitat map), and the splashed white American Paint, which has no fixed spot and appears at random hostile campfires.
Categories (base stats depend on category):
- Riding: most common, low stats.
- Draft: wagon horses, big and slow, slightly better than riding horses.
- Race: high speed and acceleration, lower stamina and health.
- War: high health and stamina, lower speed and acceleration.
- Work: high stamina, average health and speed, lower acceleration.
- Multi-class: two classes combined; rarer, pricier, above average.
- Superior: rare and expensive, can have exceptional stats.
Handling: Heavy (draft), Standard (riding, war, work, multi-class), Race (race), Elite (superior). Heavier handling feels less agile.

topics.title: Horse attributes, weight and cleanliness
topics.text:
- Four attributes: stamina, health, speed, acceleration. Each starts at the breed's default number of tanks (for example a Morgan is 2/3/3/2) and can be raised to a maximum of 10 tanks per attribute.
- Raising stats: saddle and stirrup upgrades add hidden bonuses (check Player > Horse > Tack in the pause menu), and each bonding level adds one stamina tank and one health tank.
- An empty stamina core cuts top speed by a third; a dangerously low health core has a similar penalty.
- Carrying a second person or a large animal lowers top speed and drains stamina faster uphill.
- Sleeping fully restores both horse cores. Hitching refills cores to 55%, leading to 45%.
- Galloping flat out on an empty stamina meter agitates the horse, and it may throw you; predators nearby can spook it too.
- Weight runs from 0 (starving) to 100 (obese); 50 is fit. Feeding adds weight, going without loses it, and either extreme slightly lowers top speed. Food calorie values are on page 310.
- Dirt: heavy grime (a red brush in the health core icon) makes meters drain 25% faster. Brush the horse or ride it through water.

topics.title: Horse sell prices (rates by bonding level)
topics.text:
A horse's sale price is a percentage of its base value (the stable buying price), depending on how you got it and its bonding level.
- Bought legally, sold at a stable: level 1 50%, level 2 65%, level 3 80%, level 4 95%.
- Stolen, sold at a stable: level 0 2%, level 1 4%, level 2 10%, level 3 15%, level 4 20%.
- Stolen, sold at the horse fence: level 0 4%, level 1 8%, level 2 12%, level 3 20%, level 4 30%.
You can see a horse's info by focusing on it up close or through binoculars and studying it.

topics.title: Horse bonding: XP, levels and perks
topics.text:
There are four bonding levels after the starting state. XP needed depends on the horse's total stats; totals run from 1,050 XP (50/200/300/400 per level) up to 2,450 XP (50/350/750/1,300). Bought horses start at level 1; wild and stolen ones at level 0.
XP sources:
- Breaking a wild horse 25; earning trust by riding a while 15 (up to 50 total); equipping your saddle brings it to 50.
- Patting when calm 5 (45-second cooldown); calming when agitated 15; ointment 5.
- Brushing when dirty 15, when clean 1.
- Treats 5; highly nutritious food 15/5/1 and nutritious food 5/1, depending on how full its cores are.
- Walking or trotting 2 every 5 seconds (1 if burdened); galloping 1 every 5 seconds; leading 2 every 5 seconds.
- Hitching 15 (once per area per 12 in-game hours, otherwise 1); unloading a load carried at least 2.5 in-game hours 15 (otherwise 1).
Perks by level:
- Level 1: revive window 12 minutes, whistle range 185-205 m.
- Level 2: +1 stamina and health tank, 25 minutes, 225-260 m, unlocks rearing.
- Level 3: +1/+1, 30 minutes, 280-330 m, skid turns and skid stops.
- Level 4: +1/+1, 60 minutes, 350 m, piaffe and drifting.
Whistle: range grows 1 m per 10 bonding XP within a level. Tapping the whistle repeatedly fills a hidden response bar, making your horse come at a faster gait, more so at higher levels.
Horse death: a downed horse can be saved with a horse reviver during the revive window; keep one in your satchel. If it dies, your saddle stays on the body (marked on the radar) until you collect it, or it's returned automatically when you enter a stable or start a mission. Pre-order, Special and Ultimate edition horses respawn at the Valentine stable.
You can have a main horse (saddled) and one temporary horse (bond level 1 but never saddled).

topics.title: Horse food and remedies
topics.text:
- Horse Meal: fully refills both cores and adds a gold (overpowered) core for a day.
- Beets, Carrot, Hay Cube, Classic Oat Cakes: 62 to both cores.
- Many fruits, vegetables and wild plants (corn, apple, peach, pear, ginseng, oregano, burdock root, berries, mushrooms, mint, thyme, sage, currant, feverfew) give about 12-50 to the cores; sugar cubes and peppermint act as treats.
- Horse Reviver (and Special Horse Reviver): revive a downed horse.
- Horse medicine (regular, potent, special) restores health; horse stimulants restore stamina. Potent and special versions add Fortified for 2, 4 or 10 hours.
- Horse Ointment and the Horse Care Package handle grooming; the care package also fully restores and adds gold cores for a day.

topics.title: Fast travel, trains and stagecoaches
topics.text:
Fast travel: after the right lodging upgrade at camp, a map appears on Arthur's wagon (or in his room at Shady Belle). Examine it to jump to places you've already visited: Annesburg, Emerald Ranch, Lagras, Rhodes, Saint Denis, Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn Trading Post and Blackwater.
Trains: buy a ticket at a station and arrive in seconds. Stations: Annesburg, Benedict Point, Emerald Ranch, Rhodes, Riggs Station, Saint Denis, Valentine, Wallace Station.
Stagecoaches: use a stop sign or coach driver. Stops: Annesburg, Blackwater, Emerald Station, Rhodes, Saint Denis, Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn Trading Post; plus Armadillo, MacFarlane's Ranch and Tumbleweed from Epilogue 1.
The Saint Denis trolley is a nice ride but slower than walking.

topics.title: Camp and gang morale
topics.text:
Raise gang morale by:
- Donating money and items to the tithing box and bringing game to Pearson.
- Doing chores: chopping wood, carrying hay bales to the horses, taking grain sacks to Pearson's wagon, emptying and filling water buckets.
- Buying lodging upgrades, especially Dutch's (tier 2) and everyone's tents (tier 4).
- Completing item requests for gang members.
A happy, well-stocked camp means more free supplies at the three stations (provisions at Pearson's wagon, ammo and arms at Arthur's wagon, health supplies at Strauss's wagon), a better mood, fewer complaints and more donations from others.

topics.title: Camp ledger: supply and structural upgrades
topics.text:
Unlocked after an early mission for Strauss; use the ledger outside Dutch's tent.
Supply upgrades (upgrade cost / restock cost):
- Health supplies: T1 gin, bitters, health cure (restock $15); T2 snake oil, stimulants, potent bitters ($30 / $25); T3 Kentucky bourbon, miracle tonic, Guarma rum ($50 / $45); T4 potent miracle tonic, potent health cure ($75 / $75).
- Provisions: T1 bread roll, crackers, cheese, biscuits (restock $15); T2 canned vegetables, pears, apples, salted offal ($30 / $25); T3 canned salmon, canned fruit, chewing tobacco ($45 / $40); T4 cocaine gum, candy ($55 / $50).
- Ammunition and arms: T1 regular pistol and revolver cartridges (restock $8); T2 regular repeater cartridges, arrowheads ($60 / $10); T3 throwing knives, regular shotgun shells and rifle cartridges ($90 / $15); T4 fire bottles, high velocity repeater cartridges ($110 / $20).
Structural upgrades:
- Lodging T1 (Bare-Bone Shelter): default.
- Lodging T2 (First Things First), $220: other members donate more.
- Lodging T3 (Next in Line), $325: unlocks fast travel via the map at Arthur's lodging, plus cigarettes and hair pomade.
- Lodging T4 (For Everyone!), $300: better mood, slower supply use, even more donations.
- Horse Station, $300: hitching points; fetch horses from stables or recall your main horse to camp.
- Chicken Coop, $175: eggs in Pearson's stew, making it more nutritious.
- Leather Working Tools, $225: more crafting options for Pearson (needed for satchels).
- Boat, $450: Clemens Point and Shady Belle only, for crossing water and reaching fishing spots.

topics.title: Pearson's satchel upgrades and camp decorations
topics.text:
All satchels need the Leather Working Tools ledger upgrade. Each needs an unlock condition plus pelts:
- Tonics Satchel: tier-3 health supplies upgrade; Perfect Deer, Buck and Elk pelts.
- Ingredients Satchel: donate five carcasses to Pearson; Perfect Deer, Badger and Squirrel pelts.
- Kit Satchel: donate three valuables to the tithing box; Perfect Deer, Elk and Panther pelts.
- Provisions Satchel: tier-3 provisions upgrade; Perfect Deer, Bison and Raccoon pelts.
- Materials Satchel: craft three recipes at a campfire; Perfect Deer Pelt, Perfect Boar Pelt, Perfect Iguana Skin.
- Valuables Satchel: donate $50 to the tithing box; Perfect Deer, Beaver and Rabbit pelts.
- Legend of the East Satchel: all the others first; Perfect Deer, Cougar and Wolf pelts.
Camp decorations Pearson can craft (perfect parts needed): Buck Skull (buck carcass), Fur Horse Blankets (2 coyote pelts and a bison pelt), Alligator Skull (alligator skin), Big Horn Ram Skull (ram carcass), Cougar Pelt Covered Chest (2 cougar pelts), Boar Skin Table Cover (boar pelt), Ox Hide Rug (2 ox hides), Boar Skin Rug (4 boar pelts), Pronghorn Leather Table Tops (2 pronghorn hides), Pronghorn Skull (pronghorn carcass), Moose Antlers (moose antler), Wolf Skull (wolf carcass), Snake Skin Banjo Head (2 snake skins), Campfire Seat Cover (beaver, muskrat and fox pelts), Campfire Log Seat Cover (2 wolf pelts), Scout Fire Ground Cover (2 goat hides), Elk Antlers, Hanging Bones (buck antlers).

topics.title: Gang item requests
topics.text:
Gang members ask for items (most between 8am and 8pm). Rewards come immediately or at your lodging. Five completed requests earns the Errand Boy trophy.
- Abigail (Ch 2): $5 from your savings; reward: honor.
- Bill (Ch 2-4): hair pomade (common, general stores); repeater cartridges.
- Charles (Ch 2-4): moonshine (fences) for fire arrows; oleander for poison arrows. Epilogue 2: an eagle feather (hunting) for a horse reviver.
- Dutch (Ch 2-4): pipe, on a desk in the Vetter's Echo shack west of Wallace Station near the west edge of the map; spurs.
- Hosea (Ch 2-4, if he sees you reading The Deceitful German): the book Shrew in the Fog, on a coffee table in a house in the bayou northwest of Saint Denis; predator bait. Ch 3: 2 American ginseng for potent medicine.
- Jack (Ch 2): Abigail's thimble, looted from people once the request is active. After A Fisher of Men: a Penny Dreadful comic, in one of five spots: Osman Grove shack (east of Emerald Ranch), Clawson's Rest shack (northwest of Valentine), Pleasance schoolhouse (northeast of Eris Field), Downes Ranch house (east of Wallace Station), Lake Don Julio shack (southeast of Armadillo). Rewards: a drawing from Jack for the thimble, a chocolate bar for the comic.
- Javier (Ch 2): oleander for poisoned throwing knives. Kieran (Ch 3, 12-6pm): 2 burdock root for horse medicine.
- Lenny (Ch 2-4, 8pm-3am): pocket watch, on a desk in the Vetter's Echo shack; reward: dynamite.
- Mary-Beth (Ch 2): fountain pen, in a drawer in the Osman Grove cabin east of Emerald Ranch; reward: a ring.
- Molly (Ch 3): pocket mirror at Martha's Swain cabin (east of Three Sisters); cigar.
- Pearson (Ch 2-4, 8am-12pm): a rabbit for nutritious stew. Ch 2, while playing poker: naval compass in the Braithwaite Manor boathouse for rum.
- Sadie (Ch 3-4, after Further Questions of Female Suffrage): harmonica at Granger's Hoggery shack east of Flatneck Station; gun oil.
- Sean (Ch 2-3, 12-6pm): Kentucky bourbon for a fire bottle. Susan (Ch 2-4): 2 oregano for a potent miracle tonic.
- Tilly (Ch 2, while playing dominoes): a necklace from lock boxes; 2 medicine.
- Uncle (Epilogue 2): medicinal cream, crafted from milkweed, bourbon, peppermint, pomade and stringy meat; clothes.

topics.title: Companion activities by camp
topics.text:
Time-sensitive invitations from gang members. Do one in every camp for Friends with Benefits; visit camp often so you don't miss them.
- Any time: dominoes and poker (page 220).
- Chapter 2, Horseshoe Overlook: Lenny (Five Finger Fillet), Javier (home robbery, page 182), Charles (hunting: skin a free bison and loot a camp holding the poison throwing knife pamphlet; also in Chapter 3), Sean and Bill (coach robberies, page 183).
- Chapter 3, Clemens Point: Tilly (dominoes), Javier and Kieran (fishing, each revealing a legendary fish spot), Micah (Five Finger Fillet), Javier (home robbery), Charles (bank robbery, Special/Ultimate Editions only).
- Chapter 4, Shady Belle: Micah and Lenny (coach robberies), Pearson (hunting: crayfish holes and gator eggs), Uncle (rustling a herd of cows).

topics.title: Hunting: animal quality and kill quality
topics.text:
What you get from skinning depends on the animal's quality and how cleanly you killed it.
- Animal quality: shown in its info and by stars when you study or focus on it (1 poor, 2 good, 3 pristine). Use binoculars or a scope from range.
- Kill quality depends on where you hit and with what:
- Fatal hit (brain or heart): instant death. From Dead Eye rank 4 (reached in Fleeting Joy, Chapter 5), fatal organs show red near your reticle. Big skulls need penetration, so a scoped rifle or high velocity ammo helps; changing angle avoids bones.
- Critical hit (lungs, stomach): the animal bleeds, weakens and usually collapses. Shown in red from Dead Eye rank 5 (Goodbye, Dear Friend, Chapter 6).
- Fatal and critical hits with the right weapon give clean, perfect kills.
A pristine animal plus a clean kill with a suitable weapon gives a perfect part.

topics.title: Best hunting weapon for each animal size
topics.text:
Size groups:
- Small: frogs, toads, snakes, most small birds (jays, cardinals, crows, pigeons, songbirds, ducks, chickens, pheasants, quail, gulls and more), bats, squirrels, rats, chipmunks.
- Moderate: eagles, cranes, egrets, hawks, herons, owls, pelicans, spoonbills, turkeys, vultures, condors, geese, iguanas, Gila monsters, rabbits, armadillos, badgers, muskrats, possums, raccoons, skunks.
- Medium: coyote, fox, pig, beaver.
- Large: boar, buck, cougar, panther, bighorn ram, wolf, deer, pronghorn, goat, sheep, peccary, small alligator, turtle.
- Massive: bear, bison, bull, elk, moose, ox, cow, alligator.
Weapons that can give a perfect kill:
- Small: small game arrows only (the varmint rifle is just good).
- Moderate: Varmint Rifle (.22).
- Medium (critical or fatal hit): arrows, poison arrows, throwing knives, poison throwing knives, repeaters, rifles, sniper rifles.
- Large (critical or fatal hit): arrows, poison arrows, poison throwing knives, rifles, sniper rifles.
- Massive (critical or fatal hit): poison arrows, improved arrows, poison throwing knives, rifles, sniper rifles, shotgun slugs.
- Always poor: fire and dynamite arrows, tomahawks, explosive ammo, buckshot, incendiary shells.
Horse capacity: one medium or large carcass, or one massive pelt, across the back; two moderate carcasses on the sides; many large, medium and moderate pelts on the back. Small parts go in your satchel. Massive carcasses can only be skinned, not carried.

topics.title: Legendary animals: how to hunt them
topics.text:
Sixteen unique creatures, a few met in missions but most in the wild.
- Entering a legendary's territory triggers a notice and updates your map. Use Eagle Eye to find the first clue (a question mark on the radar), follow the trail to the second and third clues, and the third trail leads to the animal.
- Bring strong weapons (rifles, sniper rifles, or the bow with poison arrows) and be fully healed and stocked.
- Kill quality doesn't matter for legendaries: their parts are the same however they die, so use your deadliest guns.
- Start with full Dead Eye; from rank 4 it shows fatal spots (usually brain and heart) for one-shot kills, and a quick volley can stop a charge.
- Each legendary is one of a kind and never returns. Skin it and take everything; if you leave irreplaceable parts behind, they're sent to the trapper automatically.
- Pelts are sold to (and crafted into outfits by) the trapper; teeth, claws and horns become talismans and trinkets at the fence (page 313).

topics.title: Fishing: baits and lures
topics.text:
Most baits and lures are sold at the Bait and Tackle shop on the west shore of Lagras. Buy the three special lures as soon as you can; they require triggering A Fisher of Fish, available early in Chapter 3.
- Cheese bait: smaller lake fish (found).
- Bread bait: smaller river fish (found).
- Corn bait: smaller swamp fish (found).
- Live worms: medium lake fish ($0.50). Live crickets: medium river fish ($0.50). Crayfish: medium swamp fish ($0.25).
- Lake, river and swamp lures: medium to large fish of that water type ($2.50 each).
- Special lake, river and swamp lures: medium to large fish and legendary fish ($20 each; the special lake lure can also be had free from the stranger mission The Veteran).
- Special spinner: all larger fish and legendary fish; reward for finishing A Fisher of Fish.

topics.title: Fish species: habitat, weather, best bait and weights
topics.text:
Small fish (redfin pickerel, perch, bullhead catfish, chain pickerel, rock bass, bluegill) live almost anywhere and mostly take food bait. Bigger fish need the right habitat, lure and weather. The guide rates each bait from A (best) to F (worst); favorite shown here.
- Redfin Pickerel: southern rivers; bread. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 10 lb 3 oz).
- Perch: northern lakes and rivers; bread. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 2 lb 9 oz).
- Bullhead Catfish: swamps; corn. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 6 lb 2 oz).
- Chain Pickerel: northern lakes, southern rivers, swamps; corn. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 9 lb 1 oz).
- Rock Bass: northern and southern lakes; cheese. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 3 lb 5 oz).
- Bluegill: lakes and rivers north and south, and swamps; cheese. 0.5-2.0 lb (legendary 4 lb 2 oz).
- Muskie: northern lakes, sunny weather; lake lure. 14-20 lb (legendary 36 lb 7 oz).
- Lake Sturgeon: southern lakes and swamps, overcast; lake lure. 14-20 lb (legendary 46 lb 0 oz).
- Northern Pike: northern rivers, sunny; river lure. 14-20 lb (legendary 46 lb 7 oz).
- Sockeye Salmon: northern rivers, sunny; river lure. 4-6 lb (legendary 54 lb 4 oz).
- Longnose Gar: swamps, overcast; swamp lure. 14-20 lb (legendary 41 lb 8 oz).
- Channel Catfish: swamps, overcast; swamp lure. 14-20 lb (legendary 180 lb 7 oz).
- Largemouth Bass: southern lakes and rivers, swamps, rain; crayfish. 4-6 lb (legendary 25 lb 1 oz).
- Smallmouth Bass: northern and southern rivers, rain; crickets. 4-6 lb (legendary 22 lb 6 oz).
- Steelhead Trout: lakes and rivers north and south, rain; worms. 4-6 lb (legendary 29 lb 8 oz).
For the big fish, the matching special lure and the special spinner rate A; regular lures B-C; food baits D-F.

topics.title: A Fisher of Fish: legendary fish quest and rewards
topics.text:
Start by speaking to Jeremy Gill, fishing on the pier on the northeast shore of Flat Iron Lake. He gives you a map of 13 legendary fish and asks you to mail each one to him.
- Any special lure works, but the one matching the water type attracts fewer ordinary fish.
- Legendary fish are usually too big for the satchel: carry them on your horse to a post office and mail them.
- Rewards: mail one fish for a Lake Lure; mail 10 for $45.00 and five succulent fish meat; mail all 13 and go with Gill for the Special Spinner.
- After all 13, Gill invites you to his shack, then on a trip to Rio Bravo for the legendary channel catfish (needs Epilogue 1).
Reeling tip: legendary fish fight long and hard and can snap your line. Each time the fish tires, pull the rod up (left stick down) and then reel quickly; repeat until it starts struggling again.

topics.title: Legendary Channel Catfish
topics.text:
The 14th legendary fish. After you mail all 13 others, Jeremy Gill takes you to Rio Bravo to catch it; the trip needs Epilogue 1.
Legendary weight: 180 lb 7 oz.

topics.title: Legendary Bullhead Catfish
topics.text:
Where: Sisika Island, just west of the penitentiary.
Lure: Special River Lure. Legendary weight: 6 lb 2 oz.

Where: Dakota River, northwest of Flatneck Station.

topics.text:
