topics.title: Core drain rates and Dead Eye upgrades
topics.text:
Main meters refill by sleeping, tonics, or over time from cores (faster if you rest on the spot). Cores refill by sleeping, bathing and eating.
Time for a core to drain from full to empty:
- Normal: 90 minutes (all cores).
- Sick, after Paradise Mercifully Departed (Chapter 5): 85 minutes.
- Very sick, after A Fork in the Road (Chapter 5): 75 minutes.
- Too hot or too cold: 10 minutes (health).
- Snake poison: 10 minutes (health).
- While mounted: 25% slower. At camp: no drain.
Dead Eye:
- It doesn't refill on its own (sleep refills part of it); each kill refills it at a rate set by its core.
- Each tagged target makes it drain 5% faster, up to 40%.
Dead Eye upgrades through the story:
- Old Friends (Ch 1): slow motion with auto-tagging as your reticle passes over targets.
- Pouring Forth Oil (Ch 2): tag multiple targets manually.
- Banking, the Old American Art (Ch 4): stay in Dead Eye when you fire without tagging.
- Fleeting Joy (Ch 5): fatal areas highlighted.
- Goodbye, Dear Friend (Ch 6): critical areas highlighted.

topics.title: Attribute growth: XP and how to earn it
topics.text:
Starting meters: health 3 tanks, stamina 2, Dead Eye 2. Natural growth caps at level 8; challenge set bonuses give two more tanks (level 10).
Total XP per level: 1 = 0, 2 = 50, 3 = 100, 4 = 200, 5 = 350, 6 = 550, 7 = 800, 8 = 1,100.
Health XP:
- Ginseng elixir: 25% of the next level (limited supply).
- Related challenge: 30 (once each).
- Rowing over 100 m: 20. Bow or thrown-weapon kill: 20. Melee knockout or kill: 10. Catching a fish: 10-30 by size. Jumping 50 times: 5. Stealth kill or knockout: 5. Bow or thrown-weapon hit: 5. Clean hunting kill: 3.
Stamina XP:
- Aged pirate rum: 25% of the next level (limited).
- Related challenge: 30. Surviving combat under 25 health: 20. Sprinting over 100 m: 20. Swimming for 15 seconds: 20.
Dead Eye XP:
- Valerian root: 25% of the next level (limited).
- Related challenge: 30. Crafting an item: 1. Cooking a meal: 1. Camp chores: 5. Finding a special collectible: 5. Free-aim kill: 1. Skinning an animal: 1-10 by animal. Headshot from over 50 m: 1-5 by distance.

topics.title: Status effects: weather, fortified, poison, gold cores, weight and drinking
topics.text:
- Harsh weather: without suitable clothing, the health core empties in 10 minutes instead of 90.
- Fortified: certain items temporarily extend an attribute to level 10, which also slows core drain by 15%.
- Poison (snake bite): health core empties in 10 minutes. Cure it with ginseng, English mace, milkweed, vanilla flower or yarrow, or by sleeping, going to camp or starting a mission.
- Gold cores: good consumables and services make a core gold, meaning no upkeep for a while; it's full when the effect ends.
- Weight runs 0 (skinny) to 20 (overweight), with 10 ideal. You lose a point every 24 in-game minutes and gain from food (one change per in-game hour and per screen fade).
- Overweight: cores drain up to 25% faster, stamina 0.75% faster per point (max 7.5%), but you take 0.75% less damage per point (max 7.5%).
- Underweight: cores drain up to 25% faster and you take 0.75% more damage per point (max 7.5%), but stamina drains 0.75% slower per point (max 7.5%).
- Alcohol values: saloon beer, saloon whiskey and opened Guarma rum, brandy and gin 0.10; opened Kentucky bourbon 0.13; Guarma rum, brandy and gin 0.17; Kentucky bourbon 0.25; moonshine 0.30; whiskey bottle 0.40; aged pirate rum 0.50.
- Drunkenness: sober 0-0.49, drunk 0.50-0.74, wasted 0.75-0.99, blackout 1. It lasts at least 90 seconds and drops 0.25 every 24 seconds after that.

topics.title: What fills and drains each attribute (summary)
topics.text:
Health: XP from rowing, bow/thrown kills, melee, stealth, fishing, ginseng elixir and challenges. The meter drains from damage; refill with tonics, sleep or rest. The core drains from hunger and tiredness; refill with sleep, a deluxe bath or food. Being overweight helps, underweight and temperature hurt, and gold cores stop drain.
Stamina: XP from sprinting, swimming, pirate rum and challenges. The meter drains from sprinting, swimming, jumping, climbing and diving. The core refills with sleep, any bath or food. Overweight hurts, underweight helps, and heat hurts.
Dead Eye: XP from crafting, cooking, skinning, chores, free-aim kills, special collectibles, long headshots, valerian root and challenges. The meter drains with use and refills with tonics, kills or sleep. The core refills with sleep, a deluxe bath or food; cold hurts.

topics.title: Hair and beard growth
topics.text:
Hair growth unlocks at the start of Chapter 2, and a big change in look makes you harder to recognize.
- Hair tonic doubles growth speed for up to two stages; two tonics give 4x and three give 8x.
- Beards stop growing at stage 6 unless you use tonic.
- Barber pomade lasts five in-game days, or two if you apply it yourself.
- Hair grows one stage at a time and only advances after a screen fade (sleep, respawn, fast travel, cutscenes, and so on).
- Time per stage: stages 1-2 take 2 in-game days each (1.6 real hours), stage 3 takes 4 days (3.2 h), stage 4 takes 8 days (6.4 h), stage 5 takes 12 days (9.6 h), stages 6-7 take 20 days each (16 h), stages 8-9 take 16 days each (12.8 h), stage 10 takes 26 days (20.8 h). Stage 0 needs the Extra Clean Shaven style from a barber.

topics.title: Honor ranks and rewards
topics.text:
Honor ranks run from -8 to +8, one rank every 40 points (+320 is rank 8, -320 is rank -8).
- Rank 2 (+80): 10% discount in all shops.
- Rank 4 (+160): new outfits in certain shops: the Bulldogger, McLaughlin, Chevalier, Corson, Cumberland, Cowpuncher, Valentine and Roscoe.
- Rank 6 (+240): 25% discount in all shops.
- Rank 7 (+280): more outfits: the Scrapper, Farrier, Gambler, Deauville, Faulkton, Drifter, Dewberry Creek and Drover.
- Rank 8 (+320): 50% discount in all shops.
- High honor: looting bodies gives more potent tonics, restorative items, jewelry and food.
- Neutral honor: mostly standard tonics, cheap jewelry, basic horse items, and used alcohol and tobacco.
- Low honor: more Dead Eye tonics, thrown weapons, alcohol and tobacco, plus more money and jewelry from lawmen.
Some missions need high honor (e.g. Do Not Seek Absolution needs rank 4 or higher).
Note: this table puts the two outfit groups at ranks 4 and 7, but the shop lists on pages 325-328 show them as rank 3 and rank 6.

topics.title: Honor gains and losses (missions and everyday actions)
topics.text:
All values are multiplied by 1.5 during Chapter 6. Chance encounters have their own honor effects (page 223).
Mission choices:
- Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?: kill the train staff -5; don't save Lenny -20.
- Polite Society, Valentine Style: rescue the escaped horse +10; return it by calming and leading +10 (by lasso drag +5); antagonize its owner -10; pull the witness up +10 (leave him -5); spare him after +10 (kill him -10); keep the stolen horse -5, return it +10.
- We Loved Once and True II: agree to rescue Jamie +10.
- The Course of True Love I: sell the gift instead of delivering it -5.
- Sodom? Back to Gomorrah: crack the safes +5; dynamite them -5.
- Fatherhood and Other Dreams: help Mary recover the heirloom +10; pay the buyer for the brooch +5.
- Brothers and Sisters, One and All: return Sister Calderón's crucifix +20.
- A Rage Unleashed: help Rains Fall +10 (refuse -10). Archeology for Beginners: help Monroe +20 (refuse -20); kill soldiers for the relics -5.
- Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow: help Sadie +20 (refuse -20).
- Do Not Seek Absolution I: help Archie +10. II: rescue Edith +10. Of Men and Angels: donate +20.
- The Course of True Love IV: escort Beau and Penelope +10; refuse her payment +10.
- Honor, Amongst Thieves: kill the wagon drivers -5.
- Red Dead Redemption: protect John gains a rank; going after the money loses a rank.
- Home of the Gentry? (Epilogue 1): pay off the squatters +5. American Venom: don't hang Cleet +5.
- Bounty hunting: return a target +5 (dead or alive); Mark Johnson, let him say goodbye +1.
- Loansharking: kill Algie's son -5; J. John Weathers absolve +10 or recover -5; Arthur Londonderry, give extra money +20.
- Willard's Rest home robbery: show the widow how to hunt, then shoot +20, then +10. The Ties That Bind Us: give the convicts medicine +10.
Everyday actions:
- +10: donate to the tithing box; disarm a dueling opponent.
- +5: surrender peacefully and serve jail time; kill rats in town or do camp chores; pay off your bounties.
- -1: let an animal bleed to death; shoot near a civilian; steal a hitched horse; knock out and loot civilians; trample an innocent.
- -5: intimidate or beat someone during a robbery; kill town animals (dogs, cows, pigs).
- -10: desecrate graves or bodies. -20: hold up a shopkeeper and take from the register or safe.
- Growing penalties for repeats: random antagonizing, leaving your hurt horse writhing, killing an animal and leaving it unskinned, killing a civilian or lawman (not when already wanted or in missions).

topics.title: Challenges: reinforced gear, set bonuses and the Legend of the East outfit
topics.text:
Nine categories of ten challenges each, done in order. Each category unlocks a four-piece reinforced set (bandolier, gun belt, holster, off-hand holster) that you then buy from the trapper.
Perks (gunsmith upgrade vs reinforced):
- Bandolier: longarm ammo +50% vs +100%.
- Gun belt: sidearm ammo +50% vs +100%.
- Holster: weapon wear -10% vs -20% (stacks).
- Off-hand holster: reinforced version adds -10% weapon wear (stacks).
Set bonuses (permanent extra tanks): a full set in one related category gives +1 tank, all three related sets give +2.
- Health: Horseman, Sharpshooter, Weapons Expert.
- Stamina: Bandit, Gambler, Master Hunter.
- Dead Eye: Explorer, Herbalist, Survivalist.
Complete every challenge to get the Legend of the East Outfit: all cores (horse too) drain 10% slower, 10% less melee damage, Dead Eye drains 10% slower for three seconds (Eagle Eye permanently), +10% attribute XP, 10% less damage on horseback, +10% looted money, and 10% slower weapon wear.

topics.title: Bandit challenges
topics.text:
1. Hold up five townsfolk: Bandit Bandolier.
2. Rob two coaches on the road or finish any two coach robbery missions: 25 Dead Eye XP, $5.
3. Rob the cash register in any four shops in one day: Bandit Holster.
4. Rob three coaches in a day: 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
5. Amass a $250 bounty in one state: 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
6. Steal five horses and sell them to the horse fence at Clemens Cove: 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
7. Rob $50 of cash and valuables from townsfolk and travelers: Bandit Off-Hand Holster.
8. Steal seven wagons and sell them to the fence at Emerald Ranch: 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
9. Hogtie someone and leave them on the railroad three times: 150 Dead Eye XP, $20.
10. Complete five train robberies without dying or being caught: Bandit Gun Belt.

topics.title: Explorer challenges
topics.text:
1. Find a treasure map: Explorer Holster.
2-10. Find a treasure each time. Rewards in order: 25 Stamina XP and $5; Explorer Bandolier; 50 XP and $10; 50 XP and $10; 100 XP and $15; Explorer Gun Belt; 100 XP and $15; 150 XP and $20; Explorer Off-Hand Holster.
Treasure hunting: page 196.

topics.title: Gambler challenges
topics.text:
1. Win five hands of poker: Gambler Holster.
2. In blackjack, double down and win five times: 25 Dead Eye XP, $5.
3. Win three games of Five Finger Fillet: Gambler Bandolier.
4. Bust one poker opponent in each location (Flatneck Station, Saint Denis, Valentine): 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
5. Win three rounds of dominoes without drawing tiles against two or fewer opponents: 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
6. Beat the blackjack dealer in two locations (Rhodes and Van Horn): 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
7. Beat the Five Finger Fillet player in every location (Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn): Gambler Gun Belt.
8. Win three blackjack hands with three or more hits: 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
9. Win three games of dominoes in a row: 150 Dead Eye XP, $20.
10. Win three hands of poker in a row: Gambler Off-Hand Holster.
Table games: page 220.

topics.title: Herbalist challenges
topics.text:
1. Pick six yarrow: Herbalist Off-Hand Holster.
2. Pick and eat four species of berry: 25 Health XP, $5.
3. Craft seven items using sage: Herbalist Gun Belt.
4. Pick five mushrooms and feed them to your horse: 50 Health XP, $10.
5. Craft nine items using Indian tobacco: 50 Health XP, $10.
6. Pick 15 different species of herb: 100 Health XP, $15.
7. Craft and use five special miracle tonics: Herbalist Holster.
8. Use oleander to craft six poison weapons: 100 Health XP, $15.
9. Pick one of each species of herb: 150 Health XP, $20.
10. Season and cook all 11 types of meat: Herbalist Bandolier.
Crafting: page 320.

topics.title: Horseman challenges
topics.text:
1. Kill five rabbits from horseback: Horseman Gun Belt.
2. Jump over three obstacles in 15 seconds: 25 Stamina XP, $5.
3. Ride from Valentine to Rhodes in under five minutes: Horseman Holster.
4. While mounted, drag a victim 3,300 feet with your lasso: 50 Stamina XP, $10.
5. Trample five animals on horseback: 50 Stamina XP, $10.
6. Ride from Strawberry to Saint Denis in under nine minutes without touching water: 100 Stamina XP, $15.
7. Kill seven enemies from horseback without dismounting: Horseman Bandolier.
8. Kill nine predators from horseback: 100 Stamina XP, $15.
9. Ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in under 17 minutes without touching water: 150 Stamina XP, $20.
10. Break every wild horse breed (page 134): Horseman Off-Hand Holster.

topics.title: Master Hunter challenges
topics.text:
1. Skin three deer: Master Hunter Off-Hand Holster.
2. Get three perfect rabbit pelts: 25 Health XP, $5.
3. Track 10 different species with binoculars: Master Hunter Bandolier.
4. Get a clean kill after calling an animal five times: 50 Health XP, $10.
5. Skin three black or grizzly bears: 50 Health XP, $10.
6. Kill five cougars with your bow, then skin them: 100 Health XP, $15.
7. Use bait to lure and kill both a herbivore and a predator: Master Hunter Gun Belt.
8. Catch three fish without a fishing rod: 100 Health XP, $15.
9. Catch an opossum playing possum: 150 Health XP, $20. Completing this makes the legendary panther appear.
10. Find and kill the legendary panther Giaguaro: Master Hunter Holster.

topics.title: Sharpshooter challenges
topics.text:
1. Kill three flying birds: Sharpshooter Bandolier.
2. Kill two different species in the same Dead Eye: 25 Dead Eye XP, $5.
3. Kill five flying birds from a moving train: Sharpshooter Holster.
4. Kill an enemy at least 80 feet away with a thrown tomahawk: 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
5. Kill six animals without switching or reloading: 50 Dead Eye XP, $10.
6. Kill someone at least 660 feet away with a long scoped rifle: 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
7. Get seven headshots in a row: Sharpshooter Off-Hand Holster.
8. Disarm three enemies without reloading or switching: 100 Dead Eye XP, $15.
9. Shoot three people's hats off in the same Dead Eye: 150 Dead Eye XP, $20.
10. Kill three flying birds with three consecutive long scoped rifle shots: Sharpshooter Gun Belt.

topics.title: Survivalist challenges
topics.text:
1. Catch three bluegill: Survivalist Gun Belt.
2. Hand five animals in to camp or the trapper: 25 Stamina XP, $5.
3. Kill five animals with a Varmint Rifle: Survivalist Off-Hand Holster.
4. Craft dynamite, fire, improved, poison and small game arrows: 50 Stamina XP, $10.
5. Catch a fish in the bayou from a riverboat and while standing on railroad tracks: 50 Stamina XP, $10.
6. Kill a scavenger feeding on a corpse five times: 100 Stamina XP, $15.
7. Kill eight small game animals with consecutive small game arrow shots: Survivalist Bandolier.
8. Craft a homing tomahawk, improved tomahawk, volatile dynamite and volatile fire bottle: 100 Stamina XP, $15.
9. Catch a fish of at least 19 lbs: 150 Stamina XP, $20.
10. Catch one of each type of fish in the world: Survivalist Holster.

topics.title: Weapons Expert challenges
topics.text:
1. Kill three enemies with a knife: Weapons Expert Holster.
2. Kill three enemies in 10 seconds with only throwing knives: 25 Health XP, $5.
3. Kill three birds of prey with only a tomahawk: Weapons Expert Gun Belt.
4. Kill 10 enemies with a shotgun using crafted ammo: 50 Health XP, $10.
5. Kill five mounted enemies, one throwing knife each: 50 Health XP, $10.
6. Kill four enemies at once with one stick of dynamite: 100 Health XP, $15.
7. Kill four enemies in a row by throwing and retrieving the same tomahawk: Weapons Expert Off-Hand Holster.
8. Kill 15 enemies with a long-barreled sidearm: 100 Health XP, $15.
9. Kill nine unaware enemies from behind with the bow: 150 Health XP, $20.
10. Kill a grizzly bear with only throwing knives, without taking damage: Weapons Expert Bandolier.

topics.title: The wanted system, step by step
topics.text:
- Bounty caps: $300 in Chapter 2, $500 in Chapter 3, then $1,500 after Sodom? Back to Gomorrah late in Chapter 3.
- No witness: the crime usually stays unknown. Seen but not identified: the witness reports an unknown culprit. Identified: stop the witness (violence or threats) or they'll report you.
- Once reported, a bounty goes on your head in that state. Each crime adds its value; your bounty shows when you enter a new area.
- Phase 1, active pursuit: lawmen try to kill you. A red circle follows you while they can see you and stays at your last known position when they can't. Resisting brings deputies, wagons, mobs, dogs and marshals.
- Phase 2, passively wanted: escape the circle and stay hidden until the gauge empties. While the bounty stands, expect more lawmen and bounty hunters on roads and at checkpoints in that state. After 12 hours, a bounty posse may hunt you in the wilderness (for high-severity crimes). Twelve high-severity crimes within 60 minutes locks certain towns down (fewer people, shops closed) for 350 in-game minutes, and being seen by any lawman restarts the chase.
- Crossing a state line ends active pursuit but not the passive phase.
- If caught you're jailed until you serve your time, which clears the bounty, or the gang breaks you out.
Reinforcements by area:
- Rhodes, Strawberry, Valentine: deputized citizens and town mobs in big shootouts.
- Cumberland Forest, Scarlett Meadows: dogs, more for worse crimes.
- Annesburg, Blackwater, Saint Denis, Tumbleweed: mounted marshals once your bounty is large.

topics.title: Hidden wanted levels and lockdown
topics.text:
- Wanted score: rises like your bounty but resets when active pursuit ends; it sets how hard the law comes at you during one spree.
- Five hidden wanted levels, by bounty: level 1 at $0, level 2 at $50, level 3 at $150, level 4 at $250, level 5 at $1,000.
- Level 1: a red outline marks the town (and its state) on the map and radar. Levels 2-3 bring tougher reinforcements in greater numbers.
- Level 4: if you've been positively identified, the district goes into lockdown and is shaded red. Lawmen spot you from further away and extra guards patrol. Shops are closed and events restricted until 350 in-game minutes pass, you die, or you pay the bounty. Being seen makes you instantly wanted.
- Always locked down: Fort Wallace and Sisika Penitentiary, plus Blackwater until the Epilogue.
- Lockdowns last longer or cover more ground after certain missions: The Sheep and the Goats, Sodom? Back to Gomorrah, Blessed are the Meek?, A Short Walk in a Pretty Town.

topics.title: Crimes, severity and bounty values
topics.text:
Low-severity crimes give you a chance to defuse when a lawman confronts you; antagonizing or not leaving raises the severity.
- Animal cruelty: low (medium for kills), $5.
- Arson: low in the wilderness, medium in towns, $5.
- Assault: high, $5.
- Bank robbery: high, $25.
- Cheating: low, $5.
- Disturbing the peace: low, $5-$10.
- Intimidation: medium, $5.
- Jail break: high, $25.
- Kidnapping: high, $10 ($15 for lawmen).
- Looting: low, $5.
- Murder: high, $15 ($20 for lawmen).
- Robbery: medium, $5-$10.
- Rustling: low, $5.
- Theft: low, $5 (horse theft is medium, $10).
- Train robbery: high, $50.
- Trespassing: low, $5.
- Vandalism: low, $5.
- Unarmed assault: low in towns, medium in the wilderness, $5.

topics.title: Dying, surrendering and escaping the law
topics.text:
Death penalty (free roam only, never in missions): you lose part of your savings, more if you die again within an hour of your last death.
- 1st death 5%, 2nd 7%, 3rd 10%, 4th 13%, 5th 15%, 6th and beyond 20%.
- Example: die at minute 1 (5%), minute 30 (7%), minute 45 (10%), then minute 110 is back to 5%, because more than an hour (65 minutes) has passed.
- The loss is capped at 20% or $150, whichever is lower; nothing is lost with $10 or less.
- Spend your money on upgrades before causing chaos.
Surrendering: after a minor crime, holster your gun and choose defuse; you may just be told to move along. If lawmen draw on you, you can surrender and go to jail rather than escalate.
Escaping:
- Break line of sight: the circle then stays on your last known spot. Walls, houses or thick bushes work; lawmen may run right past you.
- Leave the circle and the wanted gauge drains; if you're seen before it empties, the chase resumes.
- Bloodhounds almost always find you, so escape on horseback or deal with them.
- Trees, undergrowth, fences and water slow mounted pursuers.

topics.title: Coach robberies and tip-off missions
topics.text:
You can rob any coach, but it only pays well after The Spines of America (Chapter 2), when stolen coaches can go to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch. After Friends in Very Low Places (Chapter 3) six tip-off missions open: buy a tip from a post office clerk, then read the note in your satchel for the location.
- Hector #1 (Strawberry post office): ambush northwest of Blackwater. Greet the driver unarmed and mislead him to send the two mounted guards away, then kill the four in the coach and open the rear chest (lock breaker or shoot the lock).
- Hector #2: a railway bridge northeast of Strawberry. Call the driver to stop while unarmed, then surprise the guards, driver first.
- Hector #3: an armored coach heading to Strawberry; bring dynamite. The driver won't stop, so kill everyone or plant dynamite on the road and shoot it as the coach passes, then blow the doors.
- Alden #1 (Rhodes post office): ambush north of Rhodes; two drivers and two guards. Mislead the driver so a guard checks a wheel, then drop all four from behind (Dead Eye works). Drive carefully to the Emerald Ranch fence and get off the coach if the law turns up.
- Alden #2: just south of Rhodes; one driver and a passenger. Tackle the passenger and make him reveal the lock box hidden under the coach.
- Alden #3: a railway bridge north of Rhodes; two coaches and many guards. Snipe the front drivers from the bridge with a scoped rifle, let the riders come to you, then finish the rest and loot both coaches.

topics.title: Home robberies
topics.text:
All but one are available from the start of Chapter 2. The goal is the stash; some can be revisited for more story and loot. Four stashes are needed for Breaking and Entering, and two of the robberies are time-sensitive.
- Aberdeen Pig Farm (southeast of Emerald Ranch): money clips in an unguarded, hidden lock box. The couple invite you to eat and offer a strong drink; on a later visit the woman asks you to taste a dish. Refuse both. If you accept either, come back after the cutscene and check behind the portrait opposite the front door.
- Catfish Jacksons (directly south of Braithwaite Manor, also visited in loansharking): father and son. Valuables are in the son's room and a chest in the crawl space; there's a double-barreled shotgun above the fireplace, and threatening the son reveals the stash. The scene changes on each visit.
- Chez Porter (north of Valentine, across the Dakota River): the hidden stash is only accessible with Javier as a companion activity. The family shoots on sight; sneak round the back at night, quietly kill the two men (outside and inside the barn), and take the chest on the barn's upper platform. There's a pump-action shotgun up the ladder in the master bedroom.
- Lonnie's Shack (clearing south of Emerald Station; also with Sean in Chapter 3): four men arguing. Wait for them to pass out and sneak around, or kill all but one and interrogate him for a money stash. There's a Double-Action Revolver under one of the bunk beds.
- Van Horn Mansion (just south of Van Horn): at night the two occupants sleep downstairs; loot quietly, including cash on the wooden table.
- Watson's Cabin (northwest of Wallace Station): an old woman mistakes you for someone and lets you into the back rooms. The cellar ladder leads to a Semi-Auto Shotgun. Later her four sons argue inside and attack; beat them to loot the house, including the lockbox on the kitchen table.
- Willard's Rest (Chapter 6, near the northeast edge of the map): after A Fork in the Road, teach the widow Charlotte to hunt. Two or more days later, a shooting lesson and a jewelry box. Four or more days after that, she offers her collectibles, and again in the epilogue.

topics.title: Shop robberies with secrets
topics.text:
Investigate the clues first; once notified you know enough, hold up the owner to uncover the secret.
- Rhodes gunsmith: talk to the young man at the basement window, then hold up the gunsmith and make him take you down. Free the man if you like; the box holds a Lancaster Repeater.
- Saint Denis gunsmith: knock on the security door at the back of the store, hold up the owner to open it, quietly take out the guard, and go to the top floor. Knock out the guard in the illegal poker room before he shoots, take the table money, and threaten the players to reveal a safe in the wall.
- Strawberry general store: peek through the basement window at a moonshine cellar, hold up the owner to open the trapdoor, then threaten him to reveal a loose brick near the still.
- Valentine doctor: knock on either security door (surgery room or back of the building), then hold up the doctor to open the back room. Expect a fight and a run-in with the law. Grab the money and the Schofield Revolver from the box on the table and flee on horseback.

topics.title: Train robberies
topics.text:
Unlocked after Pouring Forth Oil (Chapter 2).
- Board by riding alongside and jumping on when prompted, or at a station (but that exposes you to witnesses).
- Stop the train before looting: go to the engine and threaten or knock out the driver, ideally far from towns, so a reported crime brings less law.
- Guards you throw off alive will probably report you.
- Freight trains have a few collectibles and usually one chest. Passenger trains have more chests and passengers to hold up and rob.

topics.title: Robberies with gang members (time-sensitive)
topics.text:
Only available while the gang is at a particular camp.
- Javier, home robbery (Chapter 2 or 3): go with him to Chez Porter north of Valentine, scout the barn with binoculars, wait behind the marked rock until he lights a fire, shoot the men who come out, then clear the cabin and barn. The stash is under a storage crate in the barn; push it aside together. There's also a money chest up the barn ladder.
- Sean, coach robbery (Chapter 3): ambush near Valentine from behind the marked log. When Mary-Beth stops the coach, open fire (or let Sean). The last guard grabs Mary-Beth as a hostage, so Dead Eye a headshot. Loot and leave fast.
- Bill, coach robbery (Chapter 3): northwest of Dewberry Creek. The plan goes wrong and you chase the coach, shooting guards from horseback. You can get ahead while Bill and Tilly argue by trotting to the junction ahead, where one Dead Eye can drop every guard. Let Bill plant dynamite, shoot it from a distance, and loot.
- Sean, home robbery (Chapter 3): Lonnie's Shack between Rhodes and Emerald Station. Take cover behind the logs while Sean talks, kill the gang but keep one alive to reveal the stash under a plank in the southwest corner. A Double-Action Revolver is under a bunk.
- Charles, bank robbery (Chapter 4, Special/Ultimate Edition only): the Rhodes bank. Silently kill the lone guard, unspool the wire to the marked spot, blow the wall, crack the three safes by mashing, then ride due south to escape.
- Micah, coach robbery (Chapter 4): wait behind a tree and shoot Micah's dynamite as the coach rolls over it, then headshot the survivors.
- Lenny, coach robbery (Chapter 4, start in the Shady Belle mansion): lawmen jump out of the coach soon after Lenny starts, so open fire (a Dead Eye volley works) and get away quickly.

topics.title: Bounty hunting: how it works
topics.text:
Unlocked by Good, Honest, Snake Oil (time-sensitive: Chapter 2 until That's Murfree Country at the end of Chapter 5).
- Read a bounty poster on the noticeboard at a sheriff's office or post office; the target's area appears on your map.
- Find the target and deliver them, dead or alive as the poster says. Alive is always better: knock out or lasso, then hogtie, and you get a conversation on the ride back.
- After handing them in, collect the reward from the lawman's desk.
- Bounty hunting pauses in Chapter 6 and returns after Gainful Employment near the end of Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Bounty: Lindsey Wofford (dead or alive)
topics.text:
Available after Good, Honest, Snake Oil (Chapter 2). Poster: Saint Denis police station.
Target area: east of Emerald Station, in a well-guarded fort. A big shootout starts at the only entrance, on the north side. Take cover behind either wall by the entrance so you can't be flanked, kill the Lemoyne Raider on the turret first, then the rest. Once only Wofford is left, sprint to the southwest tower, knock him out with a weapon in hand, and hogtie him.

topics.title: Bounty: Ellie Anne Swan (alive)
topics.text:
Available after Good, Honest, Snake Oil (Chapter 2). Poster: Valentine sheriff's office.
Target area: a short way east of Wallace Station, under a rock overhang by the river, talking with her boyfriend. Run straight to her with a gun drawn and knock her out with a melee hit, then deal with him. If you go for the boyfriend first she pulls a knife and becomes far more dangerous.

topics.title: Bounty: Joshua Brown (alive)
topics.text:
Available after Blessed are the Meek? (Chapter 2), once Strawberry's lockdown ends. Poster: Strawberry jail.
Ride to the abandoned mine northwest of town and inspect the campfire at the entrance. In the automatic Dead Eye (half-press to fill, then full press), shoot Brown's right hand before he grabs his gun. Chase him down and tackle or lasso him.

topics.title: Bounty: Mark Johnson (alive)
topics.text:
Available after The Joys of Civilization (Chapter 4). Poster: Rhodes train station.
He's camped northeast of Rhodes and surrenders at once, asking to say goodbye to his family. Allowing it gives a small honor boost but leads to an ambush on the way back; refusing makes the trip quieter. Hogtie him and ride to Rhodes. After you pass under the railway bridge he cuts himself loose, so lasso him again. If you let him see his son, the ambush comes here; fight or outrun it.

topics.title: Bounty: Robbie Laidlaw (alive)
topics.text:
Available after the Mark Johnson bounty and after looting the Old Harry Fen shack. Poster: Rhodes train station.
Go to the roadside cabin just southeast of Braithwaite Manor. You're jumped on entering and the bounty escapes; knock out your attacker with a weapon in hand, whistle your horse and ride northwest. He's hiding at the northwest edge of the marked cotton field and throws a fire bottle as you approach. Keep him in sight (he's on the radar too), lasso, hogtie and return to Rhodes.

topics.title: Bounty: Anthony Foreman (alive)
topics.text:
Available after Gainful Employment (Epilogue 1), and only if you didn't kill Anthony Foreman at the end of No, No and Thrice, No (Chapter 4). Poster: Saint Denis police station.
Ask the bartender at Doyle's Tavern, just northeast. Foreman bolts mid-conversation: chase him on foot, then on horseback, then lasso and hogtie him.

topics.title: Bounty: Otis Skinner (dead or alive)
topics.text:
Available after Gainful Employment (Epilogue 1). Poster: Blackwater police station.
Target area: southwest of Manzanita Post. Approach from the east and fight from the big rock beside their camp. Otis is the only one in a tall hat, so don't hit him if you want him alive. Watch for dogs and machetes. Knock him out with a weapon in hand, hogtie him, and gallop back as more Skinners arrive.

topics.title: Bounty: Elias Green (dead or alive)
topics.text:
Available after Gainful Employment (Epilogue 1). Poster: Blackwater police station.
Investigate the small camp just west of Beecher's Hope with Eagle Eye. Focusing on the tracks reveals a new area deeper in Skinner territory to the southwest. Sneak up for a free opening kill: Elias himself (bearskin hat) if you want him dead, otherwise an accomplice. Clear the rest quickly (Dead Eye) and knock Elias out before he reaches his horse.

topics.title: Bounty: Joaquin Arroyo (alive)
topics.text:
Available after Gainful Employment (Epilogue 1) and after witnessing the Del Lobo Execution chance encounter in Tumbleweed (page 226). Poster: Tumbleweed jail.
At the barn directly southwest of Benedict Point, two Del Lobos debate killing a young man. Kill them and question him about a planned train robbery. Gallop west to three Del Lobos by the railroad; Arroyo wears the red shirt. Shoot the other two from horseback, then chase and capture him.

topics.title: Bounty: Esteban Cortez (dead or alive)
topics.text:
Available after Gainful Employment (Epilogue 1) and after witnessing the Del Lobo Execution chance encounter in Tumbleweed. Poster: Tumbleweed jail.
At a mine southwest of Tumbleweed, Del Lobos are shooting dynamite in midair: use the noise to surprise them. Clear the tunnel guards; Cortez is at the end. Punch him with a gun in hand to knock him out and hogtie him. Three more attack from above as you leave, so turn and headshot them.

topics.title: Stranger missions: how they work
topics.text: Strangers appear as a question mark on the map; their names are revealed once you talk to them. Some stranger missions are covered in the story chapters because they're time-sensitive: We Loved Once and True (page 48), Brothers and Sisters, One and All (76), Help a Brother Out (76), Fatherhood and Other Dreams (77), Do Not Seek Absolution (99), Of Men and Angels (100) and The Course of True Love (100). Bigger strands such as the gunslingers, loansharking and treasure hunts have their own sections.

topics.title: Arcadia for Amateurs I-V (Albert Mason)
topics.text:
Chapter 2 onward.
- I: Albert Mason, by the river just southeast of Strawberry. A coyote stole his bag and runs west between two shacks: hit it with anything, then return the bag.
- II (2 in-game days later): northwest of Wallace Station. Fight off the wolves; short Dead Eye bursts help.
- III (48+ hours later): just north of Emerald Ranch. Herd the wild horses to the northwest back to the waypoint.
- IV (48+ hours later): east side of the Lagras swamps. Row to the three marked areas; at the westernmost, jump out and lure the alligator.
- V (2+ days later): a cutscene at a fine viewpoint just north of Horseshoe Overlook.

topics.title: The Smell of the Grease Paint I & II (Miss Marjorie)
topics.text:
Chapter 2 onward. Miss Marjorie is arguing with Bertram in the Van Horn saloon.
- Beat Bertram in a fistfight (block, then long counters).
- Find Magnifico camping in the woods southwest of Van Horn and chase him to the river (use the radar through the smoke). Cross, search the three colored smoke clouds, find him up a nearby tree, and chase him once more.
- Afterwards, go to the Saint Denis theatre to see the troupe perform; talk to the ticket taker for a letter from Miss Marjorie and your promised cut.

topics.title: Oh, Brother I-III (Proetus and Acrisius)
topics.text:
Chapter 4 onward.
- I: two brothers arguing outside the Valentine general store. Shoot the bottles on their heads; use Dead Eye so you don't hit them.
- II (24+ hours later): behind the Valentine saloon, they ask you to punch them.
- III (24+ hours later): at Cumberland Falls west of Valentine, push the barrels, then ride with Helen downstream to the marked area.

topics.title: Fundraiser
topics.text: From the start of Chapter 2 to the end of Chapter 6. In northwest Saint Denis near the tailor, a lady is raising money for a veterans' building. Donating the $20 she asks gives a little honor. Looting her lock box nets a few dollars but costs a lot of honor and brings the law. The building is built either way by the epilogue.

topics.title: He's British, of Course I-V (Margaret)
topics.text:
Available after The New South (Chapter 3).
- I & II: Margaret sits on an overturned circus caravan between Emerald Station and Rhodes. Find the "zebra" southwest of Emerald Station, calm or lasso it, and ride it back.
- III: meet her assistant at the northeast edge of Rhodes, use Eagle Eye on the shrubs to follow the trail north to the dead "lion", load it in the wagon, hide behind the marked log, and slam the door once the "tiger" jumps in. Drive back.
- IV & V: the last animal is in the Emerald Ranch barn. Follow its trail to the stalls just north of the barn, tag its head several times in the automatic Dead Eye, and take the lion's paw trophy. Margaret rewards you with an emerald.

topics.title: No Good Deed
topics.text:
Available after American Distillation (Chapter 3) plus any two other story missions; start between 6am and 6pm. The stranger sits on a crate northeast of the Rhodes saloon.
Ride to the waypoint to the northeast. The wagon is by the river on the southwest side of Macomb's End, guarded by thugs; stealth isn't possible, so start the fight from the front and use tree cover. Drive the wagon back to the doctor; a couple of riders attack on the way.

topics.title: The Iniquities of History (Jeremiah Compson)
topics.text:
Available after An Honest Mistake (Chapter 3). Jeremiah Compson lies on a bench outside Rhodes station.
Go to his old house to the north and enter by the back door. Get the antique pocket watch from the living room fireplace (four letters can be read too). Examining the photo on the second fireplace brings two knife-wielding thugs. Then take Compson's broken pistol, open the trap door in the parquet floor, and find the ledger (and a diary) in the secret basement. Meet Jeremiah at the waypoint. Killing him after confronting him gains honor.

topics.title: The Ties That Bind Us I-V (Mr Black and Mr White)
topics.text:
Available after The Joys of Civilization (Chapter 4). Two escaped prisoners outside Rhodes want five wanted posters gone:
- One held by a bounty hunter outside the saloon (take it by force).
- On the telegraph post opposite the doctor's office.
- On the telegraph post outside the gunsmith (beat up the man leaning there first; mind witnesses).
- On the noticeboard inside the train station.
- On the noticeboard beside the sheriff's office.
Meet them at a campfire directly south of the station. Turn them in for the bounty (this ends the strand) or burn the posters.
- III-V (24+ hours later): they're camped at Dewberry Creek north of Rhodes, both sick; give them a health cure (craft or buy one from a doctor; worth honor). One day later, a last scene at the raised wooden cabin northwest of Strawberry.

topics.title: The Artist's Way I-IV (Charles Châtenay)
topics.text:
Available after The Joys of Civilization (Chapter 4). Start at Doyle's Tavern in Saint Denis.
- II (1 day later): save Châtenay from a gunman in a back alley in the city center.
- III (24 hours later, 6am-6pm): help him in a brawl at the art gallery, then walk with him.
- IV (48 hours later): he's disguised as a woman near the gunsmith; escort him to the docks and knock out the attackers with a gun in hand.
Two days later his letter says the drawing he gave you is now worth much more; sell it to a fence.

topics.title: A Bright Bouncing Boy I & II (Marko Dragic)
topics.text:
Available after The Joys of Civilization (Chapter 4).
- I (6am-6pm): Marko Dragic is in the park in southwest Saint Denis. Steer his remote boat on the lake to blow up stationary warships, avoiding or detonating the homing mines from a distance; then do the same against moving sailboats, waiting at the start and leading your shots.
- II (24 hours later, only during a thunderstorm, 10pm-5am): at Doverhill in the far northeast. Use the detector (the coil flashes faster when close) to place three lightning conductors: one in the area right in front of you, one up the hill directly northwest, one to the east. Climb the tower opposite the lab and flip the two side switches, then the middle one.
Visit again 48+ hours later for the electric lantern and Marko's fate, which leads to a special character (page 234).

topics.title: The Mercies of Knowledge I-VII (Professor Bell)
topics.text:
Available after The Joys of Civilization (Chapter 4). The professor is in the Saint Denis slums in the northeast of the city.
- Ask Alden at the Rhodes station (6am-6pm) about the moonshine and read the note. Rob the coach at the three-way junction in Bluewater Marsh north of Saint Denis (call the driver to stop, then shoot the guards), and drive it back slowly, since the cargo is fragile.
- At the police station, the chief wants $100 for a permit. Negotiating drops it to $50; asking aggressively raises it to $150.
- V-VII: capture the bounty McDaniels alive, camped with companions just north of the railway northwest of Emerald Station. Stay mounted, chase him when he flees, lasso and hogtie him, and expect an ambush on the way back.
- 24+ hours later, the finale at the gallows in central Saint Denis. Loot the professor's body for the electric chair blueprint.

topics.title: The Wisdom of the Elders I-IV (Obediah Hinton)
topics.text:
Available after Fleeting Joy (Chapter 5).
- I: at the foot of the long railway bridge directly west of Van Horn; carry the collapsing man to Butcher Creek just north.
- II (24 hours later, 12am-7am): kill the mangy dogs behind the house (melee then hip fire if they're close), save the villager by the bridge and another crossing it, and escort both home.
- III: in the forest southwest of Butcher Creek, destroy 13 cursed objects hanging in trees. Eagle Eye shows their wind chimes, and a red dot flashes on the radar when you're near one.
- IV: at the mine northwest of Butcher Creek, remove the plank by mashing and go in. After the blast, go left. The fumes drain your health, so move steadily but loot the bodies. Back in Butcher Creek, take the bill stacks and letter on the table.

topics.title: Idealism and Pragmatism for Beginners I-III (Mayor Lemieux)
topics.text:
Available after The Gilded Cage (Chapter 4) once you open Mayor Lemieux's letter; 10pm-5am only.
- I: from the mayor's house on the northwest edge of Saint Denis, drive to the art gallery to the east and tail Professor Shiftacre. When he turns left toward the fountain with no witnesses, beat him until he's suitably scared, then report to Jean Marc.
- II (second letter): north of Saint Denis, trot alongside the red coach, jump aboard and intimidate Hector Fellowes.
- III: confront Jean Marc outside his house on Rue de Zacharie, a couple of blocks south, and carry him to the mayor's unseen: through the park ahead, out the northeast exit, then west and north. Letting him go gains honor; killing him (and dumping him in the water) costs a little honor but gives a permanent 10% discount in all Saint Denis shops.

topics.title: The Veteran I-IV (Hamish Sinclair)
topics.text:
Chapter 6 onward. The stranger sits against a rock by O'Creagh's Run, west of Annesburg.
- I: calm and pat his horse Buell by the lake to the east and lead him back. The man introduces himself as Hamish Sinclair.
- II (24 hours later, 6am-6pm): row out, fish with the special lake lure, rescue Hamish when he falls in, then fight the legendary northern pike (use the advanced reeling technique on page 165).
- III (24 hours later, 6am-6pm): track a wolf with Eagle Eye into a pack ambush. Melee then hip fire if one bites; an automatic Dead Eye triggers as the alpha charges.
- IV (24 hours later, 6am-6pm): track a legendary boar back to Hamish, check the dead wolf on the hill, gallop toward the gunfire, and tag the boar's head several times in the automatic Dead Eye. Take its trophy. You can claim Buell afterwards or stable him.

topics.title: The American Inferno, Burnt Out I-V (Evelyn Miller)
topics.text:
Available after The Landowning Classes (Epilogue 1).
- I (6am-6pm): Evelyn Miller is on a rocky promontory southwest of Strawberry.
- II (24 hours later): his cabin at Tanner's Reach, straight west from Manzanita Post. Ride with him, free the trapped animal, then knock out or kill the men at the hunter camp.
- III and IV (a day apart): he's too busy to eat; leave food at his door (buy, hunt or cook some).
- V (48+ hours later): take the platinum pocket watch from his desk, then set the curtain on fire as he asked.

topics.title: American Dreams
topics.text:
Available after all three Murder Scene chance encounters (page 223), which give you the pieced-together map; 10pm-5am only.
Open the basement doors at Lucky's Cabin, a short way southwest of Valentine. Grab the collectibles and inspect the knife. When attacked, stun him, punch him out, hogtie him and take him to the Valentine waypoint. When he goes for the sheriff, Dead Eye a headshot to earn a billfold; if you don't step in, the sheriff kills him but you get nothing.

topics.title: A Fine Night For It
topics.text:
Available after any one of the Torch Procession, Stalking Shadows, Spooked Horse or Voice chance encounters; 10pm-5am only.
The stranger camps in the bayou just northwest of Lagras. Agree to help and follow him home. Surprise the first of the Night Folk, then headshot the rest as they rush you. Inside, more arrive: hold the railing and kill machete wielders first, since one hit can kill you.

topics.title: Gunslingers: The Noblest of Men, and a Woman
keywords: noblest of men and a woman
topics.text:
From Chapter 2, talk to Theodore Levin at the bar in Keane's Saloon on the east side of Valentine. He gives you four photos and a camera.
For each gunslinger: flip the photo in your satchel to read the back (this starts the mission), go to the waypoint, and afterwards pick up their unique weapon from the ground (your only chance) and photograph the full body.
- Emmet Granger: small homestead directly east of Flatneck Station. Clean the hog pen (scoop manure into the wheelbarrow), then plant dynamite on the manure store. A duel is unavoidable and he can't be disarmed; half-press then full-press to Dead Eye and headshot him. Take his weapon.
- Billy Midnight: ask the Rhodes station clerk about him, board the arriving train and find him in the bar car. Chase him onto a carriage roof and duel; he crouches, so aim low. He dies however it goes. Take his pistol.
- Flaco Hernandez: near Cairn Lake, a short way southeast of Colter. Threaten or kill his guards, call him out with weapons holstered, and duel; aim for the head, since disarming him only makes him draw a second gun. Take his revolver.
- Black Belle: a stilt cabin in Bluewater Marsh directly north of Saint Denis. Detonate the explosives on her signal and help her fight waves of bounty hunters; kill the Gatling gunner on the wagon quickly. No weapon to collect.
Parts III-IV: with all four photos and A Fine Night of Debauchery done, ask the bartender at the old Valentine saloon about Calloway, then go to the Grand Korrigan riverboat in Saint Denis and speak to the guard.
- Slim Grant: ask the lawman in the Annesburg sheriff's office, clear the outlaw camp west of Annesburg on the river's north bank, cut Grant free and take him to Brandywine Drop to the northeast. Duel him with Dead Eye and take his gun.

topics.title: Loansharking: all of Strauss's debtors
topics.text:
All of Strauss's money lending jobs are time-sensitive and must be done before a key point in Chapter 6 (see the page 94 flowchart).
- Mr Wrobel (Part I & II, Ch 2): small house just west of camp; loot it to settle the debt, and take his horse if you like.
- Chick Matthews (I & II): under a canopy west of Emerald Ranch. The man on the uprooted tree points him out; lasso him as he flees (killing him costs honor). You get a treasure map: check the hole in the marked tree.
- Lilly Millet (I & II): bench at the north edge of Emerald Ranch; beat Cooper and stop any witnesses.
- Thomas Downes (III): southwest of Valentine (see the mission entry).
- Gwyn Hughes (Part IV in Ch 3 or V in Ch 4): outside the house next to the Rhodes gunsmith. Follow him to the churchyard, clear the townsfolk, guard the entrance while he digs (beat or scare off the two men who try to enter), then take the diamond brooch.
- Winton Holmes (IV or V): on the heights just north of Strawberry. The hardest one: a cougar in a dark cave. After you split at the fork and find Winton's body, stay by his lantern, watch the radar for the red dot, and Dead Eye the cougar the moment it appears. Sell the pelt to the Strawberry butcher.
- Algie Davison (V, Ch 4): drinking by the river just south of Braithwaite Manor. At his house, taking the box he hands you or the drink his son pours starts a fight. Knock him out and search. There's a double-barreled shotgun on the living room fireplace, and the real prize is in a chest in the son's bedroom.
- J. John Weathers and Arthur Londonderry (VI & VII, Ch 6): see Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII.

topics.title: Treasure hunting: how treasure maps work
topics.text: Available from the start of Chapter 2. Each treasure map has drawings and clues: work out the place, go there and find the next map. Solving three maps leads to a fourth that points to the treasure. The guide recommends solving them unaided; the entries below spell out every hiding place if you're stuck. Treasures count toward the Explorer challenges (page 172).

topics.title: Jack Hall Gang treasure
topics.text:
Chapter 2 onward.
- Start: Maximo, a stranger with binoculars just west of Flatneck Station, sells the map for $10 (or $5 if you decline). You can rob him for a little honor loss; if the map is lost, a fence sells it.
- Map 1 points to Caliban's Seat, just north of Horseshoe Overlook. From the clifftop, edge along the narrow ledges to a crack in the rock holding map 2.
- Map 2: Cotorra Springs, directly west of Bacchus Bridge, in one of the rock piles near the geysers.
- Map 3: O'Creagh's Run (Grizzlies East), far north of Emerald Station. Swim to the small island in the lake and check the bushes. The treasure is under a rock: two gold bars.

topics.title: High Stakes treasure
topics.text:
Available after The New South (Chapter 3).
- Map 1: from the Treasure Hunter chance encounter (it can happen at several spots). When you see a man with binoculars, rush him and knock him down or hogtie him to loot the map; take too long and he rides off. After three failed attempts, fences sell the map.
- Map 1 leads to Cumberland Falls, a short way east of Wallace Station. Go behind the waterfall and climb to the ledge above; map 2 is behind a rock in a small nook.
- Map 2: Barrow Lagoon, the frozen lake in the West Grizzlies northwest of Valentine. Map 3 is in a small hole in the log bridge to the island.
- Map 3: a winding cliff-edge path southwest of Bacchus Station. Climb down the ledges to a small overhang (crouch to get through); three gold bars are in a crevice on the far side.

topics.title: Le Trésor des Morts treasure (bonus)
topics.text:
Only for digital pre-order and Special/Ultimate Edition owners.
- Map 1: in the burned settlement just southwest of Horseshoe Overlook, the stone jailhouse is the only building left standing. The map is next to one of the two corpses inside.
- Map 2: at the Saint Denis docks, in the underground passage between the Cornwall Freight Station yard and the harbor. Check the wall beside the only wooden crate.
- Map 3: the Saint Denis cemetery, at the mausoleum with a stained-glass window west of the central dome, just north of the main path. Check the wall on your left for a hole with five gold bars.

topics.title: Cigarette cards: Smoking and Other Hobbies
topics.text:
144 cards in 12 sets of 12. Each card has a fixed pickup spot (map on pages 204-205), but one card per set only appears once you start Smoking and Other Hobbies.
- Start: after Who is Not Without Sin (Chapter 2), talk to the stranger on the bench outside Flatneck Station. Mail him each complete set for a reward.
- Premium cigarette packs (bought, found or looted) also give a random card, possibly a duplicate; sell duplicates to a fence.
Set rewards:
- First set mailed (any): Vintage Civil War Handcuffs.
- Famous Gunslingers: Special Snake Oil, $50. Artists, Writers & Poets: Ginseng Elixir, $100. Vistas of America: Gold Nugget, $100. Gems of Beauty: Platinum Chain Necklace, $100. Flora of America: Special Miracle Tonic, $50. Stars of the Stage: Small Jewelry Bag, $50. Fauna of America: Perfect Rabbit Pelt, $50. Marvels of Travel: Aged Pirate Rum, $50. World Champions: Valerian Root, $50. Amazing Inventions: Volatile Dynamite, $100. Horses: Special Horse Medicine, $50. Prominent Americans: Eagle Feather x3, $50.
- All sets: $200.

topics.title: Cigarette cards: Famous Gunslingers (001-012)
topics.text:
Spot hints (the map on page 204 shows where):
- 001 Frank Heck: on a gravestone.
- 002 Otis Miller Boys: in the back of the blue wagon.
- 003 Jack Hall Gang: inside the shack, on a windowsill.
- 004 Butcher Brothers: on a barrel on the shack's porch.
- 005 Flaco Hernández: on the edge of the bank's roof (ladder at the back).
- 006 Slim Grant: on a barrel by the derelict shack's entrance.
- 007 Landon Ricketts: on a barrel behind the house facing the undertaker.
- 008 Black Belle*: on a barrel at the end of the pier.
- 009 Billy Midnight: on the windmill tower's platform.
- 010 Emmet Granger: under a lean-to opposite two white tents inside Fort Wallace (Chapter 6, from The King's Son until Our Best Selves); also on a barrel on the porch of a small farmhouse just south of Valentine.

topics.title: Exotics for Algernon Wasp (Duchesses and Other Animals)
topics.text:
After The Gilded Cage (Chapter 4), find Algernon Wasp in a wrought-iron greenhouse behind a large blue house just north of Saint Denis. Meeting him is stage I; five more stages follow in order, each with a shopping list.
- Plumes come from rare birds in the bayou, especially on and around the Lagras islands. Gator egg nests are in the same area, often guarded by alligators.
- Orchids can be picked once per stage at each spot (map on page 206 and the atlas). Many grow on tree trunks: Rat Tail, Acuna's Star, Cigar, Clamshell, Ghost, Lady of the Night, Spider and Night Scented. Spare orchids can be mailed to a buyer who posts notices at post offices.
- Stage II: 5 Little Egret Plumes, 5 Reddish Egret Plumes, 5 Snowy Egret Plumes, 15 Lady of the Night Orchids. Reward: $110.
- Stage III: 20 Heron Plumes, 7 Lady Slipper Orchids, 10 Moccasin Flower Orchids. Reward: $125.
- Stage IV: 25 Gator Eggs, 3 Acuna's Star Orchids, 7 Cigar Orchids, 5 Ghost Orchids. Reward: $150.
- Stage V: 30 Spoonbill Plumes, 5 Night Scented Orchids, 10 Rat Tail Orchids, 5 Spider's Orchids. Reward: $175.
- Stage VI (Epilogue 1 onward): 5 Clamshell, 5 Dragon's Mouth, 5 Queen's and 10 Sparrow's Egg Orchids. Reward: $200, the Exotic Hat and Algernon's Revolver.

topics.title: Dinosaur bones (A Test of Faith)
topics.text:
Start from Chapter 2 by talking to the fossil hunter just southeast of Horseshoe Overlook. Deborah MacGuiness asks you to find 30 bones and mail their coordinates from any post office.
Rewards: 1 bone mailed, a Quartz Chunk; 15 bones, a Skull Statue; 30 bones, her invitation, and at her ranch at Firwood Rise in Cumberland Forest (in the barn) the Jawbone Knife.
