topics.title: Hunting requests for Ms Hobbs (A Better World, A New Friend)
keywords: a better world a new friend
topics.text:
Hunting request notices hang at the post office or station in Valentine, Rhodes, Strawberry, Saint Denis, Van Horn and Armadillo. There are five, collected one at a time (any town gives the next stage). Mail Ms Hobbs the perfect carcasses listed; you need pristine animals and perfect kills (page 146).
- #1: rabbit, squirrel, cardinal. $50.
- #2: rat, woodpecker, chipmunk. $70.
- #3: opossum, oriole, robin. $100.
- #4: songbird, sparrow, toad, skunk, bullfrog. $120.
- #5 (Epilogue 1 onward): cedar waxwing, bat, blue jay, crow, beaver. $150 and her letter.
The letter invites you to her cottage just northeast of Strawberry, completing A Better World, A New Friend; she gives you a squirrel statue for Beecher's Hope.

topics.title: Dreamcatchers and the ancient arrowhead
topics.text:
20 dreamcatchers hang from trees across the map (positions on the page 213 map and in the atlas). Stand under one and inspect it.
Reward: once you've inspected all 20, go into the cave behind the Elysian Pool waterfall in Roanoke Ridge. From the main chamber, climb the steep slope to an alcove with cave paintings on the right, and examine the large buffalo with a hole in its eye for the Ancient Arrowhead. It makes your stamina last twice as long while drawing your bow.

topics.title: Special tonics: aged pirate rum, ginseng elixir, valerian root
topics.text:
Each special tonic gives 25% of the XP needed for that attribute's next level: Aged Pirate Rum (stamina), Ginseng Elixir (health), Valerian Root (Dead Eye). Most are fixed collectibles (numbers 701-768 in the atlas; full list of spots on page 214).
Other sources:
- Aged Pirate Rum: Lemoyne Raider campfires; giving money to the Beggar in Saint Denis; the Moonshine Camp chance encounter (first time); the Marvels of Travel card set reward.
- Ginseng Elixir: Skinner campfires; the Artists, Writers & Poets card set reward.
- Valerian Root: O'Driscoll campfires; the Crashed Wagon chance encounter; the World Champions card set reward.
Two spots (720 and 764) are in a crashed train carriage that's hard to reach; you need two sprinting jumps, so judge them carefully.

topics.title: Chests and lock boxes
topics.text: Many hidden chests and lock boxes (numbers in the 300 range in the atlas) hold jewelry, cash, recipe pamphlets and consumables that boost attribute XP. Pages 216-217 list every chest's contents and hiding spot; highlights include gold bars, a Female Fertility Statue, and pamphlets for special tonics, poison and dynamite arrows, homing tomahawks, incendiary buckshot, explosive slugs, volatile fire bottles and more. Each chest is also shown on its atlas page with its contents.

topics.title: Enemy gangs, ambushes, campfires and hideouts
topics.text:
Gangs: O'Driscolls, Murfree Brood, Lemoyne Raiders, Skinner Brothers, Laramie, Del Lobo and Night Folk, each with its own territory (map on page 219). From Epilogue 1, O'Driscoll spawn points become generic outlaw ambushes; in Chapter 6, Pinkertons can ambush you too.
- Ambushes: they block the road or surprise you. Don't fight from the saddle; you can't take cover and your horse may get hit. Dismount, get to cover, then loot and leave before witnesses arrive.
- Gang chance encounters: they're robbing someone else, and it's your choice to step in (page 223).
- Campfires: small gang camps. Sneak to cover and open with a headshot; there's usually loot and a small chest.
- Hideouts: clear everyone in the area to capture them. All six count toward total completion. Story missions take Six Point Cabin (Paying a Social Call), Shady Belle (The Battle of Shady Belle), Beaver Hollow (That's Murfree Country) and Hanging Dog Ranch (Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow); clearing them earlier also counts. The Murfrees retake Beaver Hollow in the Epilogue. After Chapter 6, Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer in New Austin can be captured. Twin Rocks is a bonus hideout for Special/Ultimate Edition owners.
- Hideout tips: bring your best guns, lots of ammo and tonics, and full Dead Eye. Fight from solid cover with quick headshots and advance one cover spot at a time.

topics.title: Poker rules and hand ranks
topics.text:
Win the pot with the best hand or by bluffing. Unlocked after Who is Not Without Sin.
- Two players left of the dealer post the small and big blinds. Everyone gets two hole cards.
- Actions: check (bet nothing if no one has bet), bet, call (match), raise (at least double the previous raise or the big blind), fold, all in (if you can't cover the bet you only win part of the pot). Hold the auto-bet button to preset your next move.
- Rounds: preflop, flop (three shared cards), turn (fourth), river (fifth), then showdown. Kickers break ties; an exact tie splits the pot.
Hand ranks, best to worst: royal flush (A-K-Q-J-10 same suit), straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, one pair, high card.

topics.title: Blackjack rules
topics.text:
Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Available from the start of Chapter 2.
- Bet, then you and the dealer get two cards (one of the dealer's is hidden).
- Your options: hit, stand, double down (two cards only: double your bet and take exactly one more card), split (a matching pair becomes two hands, each with your original bet).
- The dealer hits below 17 and stands on 17 or more. A tie is a push and you get your chips back.
- Card values: 2-10 face value, K/Q/J are 10, ace is 1 or 11.
- Blackjack (ace plus a ten-value card as your first two) pays 3:2 unless the dealer also has one. A split hand can't be a blackjack.
- Insurance (when the dealer shows an ace): bet up to half your stake; it pays 2:1 if the dealer has blackjack. With a blackjack yourself you can take even money (1:1) instead.

topics.title: Dominoes rules and variants
topics.text:
28 tiles; everyone starts with seven and the rest form the boneyard. Available from the start of Chapter 2.
- The highest double opens (or the highest tile). Match pips at either end; if you can't, draw from the boneyard until you can, then pass once it's empty.
- The first to play all their tiles wins the round. If the game is blocked, the lowest pip count wins.
- Draw (standard): the winner scores the pips left in the losers' hands; first to 60.
- Block: no boneyard.
- All Threes: score the open-end total whenever it's a multiple of three; the round winner gets opponents' pips rounded to the nearest three; first to 90.
- All Fives: the same with multiples of five; first to 100.
- Spinners: doubles are laid crosswise and can branch on all four sides.
Tip: track played tiles and who passes to guess hands and block opponents.

topics.title: Five Finger Fillet
topics.text:
Stab a knife between your fingers by pressing the button sequence (one lap) quickly; a wrong or slow press stabs your hand. After each lap you can show off with a trick. Bet first; new opponents raise the stakes and difficulty. Win two rounds to win the game. Available from the start of Chapter 2.
- Classic: finish a set number of laps faster than your opponent, with five attempts; a mistake restarts the timer.
- Guts: most laps in 20 seconds.
- Burnout: most laps in 30 seconds with no mistakes, in one attempt.
Tip: hold the aim button during your opponent's turn to watch and learn the sequence.

topics.title: Chance encounters that unlock missions
topics.text:
Chance encounters show as temporary gray blips on the radar; go closer to get involved. Most affect your honor depending on what you do. These ones unlock more content (map on page 223):
- Treasure Hunter: a man with a map and binoculars; loot his map to start the High Stakes treasure (page 197).
- Torch Procession, Stalking Shadows, Spooked Horse or Voice (Night Folk in the bayou): any one unlocks A Fine Night For It (page 191).
- Murder Scenes: three scenes, each with a map piece in the victim's head; all three unlock American Dreams (page 191).
- Del Lobo Execution (Epilogue 1 onward): a deputy brings a Del Lobo to Tumbleweed and the sheriff executes him; unlocks the Joaquin Arroyo and Esteban Cortez bounties (page 185).

topics.title: Wilderness chance encounters (Animal Attack to Hunter)
topics.text:
- Animal Attack (person surrounded by predators): save +10; watch them die -10; leave -5; save then murder -20.
- Animal Mauling: scare off the predator, give medicine, give whiskey, or end his suffering if asked: +2 each; watch or leave -5.
- Approach: a man asks for help then tries to steal your horse; offering help +2.
- Arms Deal: outlaws buying a wagon of guns; there's ammo in the wagon chest.
- Bear Trap: free him +10 (+5 more for whiskey); watch him bleed out -20; leave -5; rob him first -2; save then murder -20 (-1 for stealing his horse).
- Boat Attack: Murfrees dumping a body; no reward beyond loot.
- Booby Trap: you fall in a pit and get ambushed; jump to climb out.
- Bounty Transport: turn the prisoner in yourself +5; freeing him may earn a robbery tip; killing him while tied -2.
- Burning Bodies (Epilogue): man at Coots Chapel; killing him -15.
- Camp Attack: Murfrees or Skinners warn or attack you while you camp on their land.
- Camp Stranger: let her sit +5; scare her off -2; kill her -10; antagonize her after letting her stay -5.
- Campfire Ambush: Murfrees jump you at a campfire; Dead Eye helps.
- Chain Gang: prisoners kill their guards; -8 for each lawman you kill.
- Checkpoint: Lemoyne Raiders searching a wagon; intervene +5; kill the driver -10; steal the wagon -1.
- Coach Robbery: save the victims +10; intervene but they die +2; let them be murdered -10; leave -5; loot the lock box.
- Corpse Cart: Murfrees' cart with a living victim; save +10; don't -5.
- Crashed Wagon: agree to guard it +2; steal without agreeing -2, after agreeing -5; one-time valerian root in the lock box. A variant has two outlaws arguing.
- Del Lobo Posse (Epilogue).
- Drunk Camp: give whiskey and he tells you about Fort Riggs.
- Escort: take the stranded woman home +10; ignore or decline -2; kill -20; terrorize -5.
- Executions: Lemoyne Raiders executing federal workers; save +10; intervene +2; watch -5.
- Fleeing Trespasser: Gray vs Braithwaite chase; you can stop the trespasser.
- Friendly Outdoorsman: explains a plant. Frozen to Death: loot a document from the camp. Fussar Chase (Chapter 5): save the islanders +5.
- Gold Panner: wait and he may find a nugget; stealing it -2.
- Horse Race: kicking or attacking your rival -2; killing them after agreeing -10.
- Hostage Rescue: save the spouse +10; kill the asker -10; watch the victim die -10; kill the tied victim -10; save then kill -20.
- Hunter: bear version, save him +5; kill him after helping -20; loot him -1; you can skin the bear.

topics.title: Wilderness chance encounters (Inbred Kidnap to Spooked Horse)
topics.text:
- Inbred Kidnap (Murfrees): save her +10; ride her home +5; agree then fail to take her home -5; don't untie her right away -5; watch -10; save then murder -20.
- Injured Rider: get him to the doctor alive +10 (may lead to a Public Hanging later); kill him -5.
- Kidnapped Victim (on a rider's horse): save +10; don't untie at once -5; save then kill -20; ignore -5.
- Laramie Gang Rustling (Epilogue): intervene +2; kill the Laramie and save the ranchers +10; kill the victims after -20; watch -5.
- Locked Safe: wait for the outlaws to open it, or blow it yourself.
- Lone Prisoner: shoot his chains +5, or hogtie him and turn him in for a bounty.
- Lost Friend: use Eagle Eye to find the frozen friend; tell him +5; refuse -2.
- Lost Man: lead him to town +5 (he tells a story); refusing from Chapter 6 -2.
- Moonshine Camp: find their plants with Eagle Eye; +2 and a chest (aged pirate rum the first time).
- Murder Scene: three to find, each with a map piece; all three unlock American Dreams.
- Naked Swimmer: greet him and he shows you a big-fish spot.
- Outlaw Looter, Outlaw Transport: no special effects.
- Poisoned: save him +5; watch or ignore -5; kill after helping -20; the herb he ate is nearby.
- Posse Breakout: Bill's been caught by bounty hunters; free him +5; refuse -2; loot the camp.
- Prison Wagon: free the prisoner +10 (maybe a robbery tip); -5 per lawman killed.
- Rally Ceremony, Rally Dispute, Rally Setup (hooded rallies): break them up, +2 each.
- Rifle Practice (Lemoyne Raiders), Road Ambush (night): no special effects.
- Savage Aftermath (Epilogue): mercy for a dying scalped man +5; killing the survivor dog -5. Savage Fight (Epilogue): intervene +2, save them +5, watch -5. Savage Wagon (Epilogue): nothing special.
- Sharpshooter: target-shooting wager; cheat -2; rob -5; kill him or run without paying -5; win and he ups the stakes next time; walking away from winnings earns honor.
- Skipping Stones: a sad boy tells his story; can recur after the Epilogue begins.
- Snake Bite: save him +20 (may trigger a Consequence reward in town); watch or ignore -5; kill after helping -20.
- Spooked Horse: a dead horse left by the Night Folk spooks yours; counts toward A Fine Night For It.

topics.title: Wilderness chance encounters (Stalking Shadows to Wilderness Hanging)
topics.text:
- Stalking Shadows: a man crosses the road and spooks your horse; follow him and the Night Folk ambush you. Counts toward A Fine Night For It.
- Stranded Rider: either the horse kicks him dead, or it runs off; return it +5; refuse -2; kill after agreeing -10.
- Torch Procession: two Night Folk dumping a body in the swamp; counts toward A Fine Night For It.
- Torturing Captive (Murfrees): intervene +2; cut him free +10; watch or ignore -5.
- Train Holdup: intervene +2; watch the victims die -5.
- Trapped Woman (under her horse): genuine or bait for an ambush. Help +5; take her home +5; refuse -5; agree then fail to take her home -5; kill while trapped -10; save then murder -20; in the trap version, killing her before you know -5.
- Treasure Hunter: steal his map to start High Stakes; -5 for stealing.
- Voice: someone calls for help in the night swamp; it's a Night Folk ambush. Counts toward A Fine Night For It.
- Wagon Threat (Epilogue, Laramie): save the owners +10; watch -10; ride off -5; save then kill -20.
- Washed Ashore: a small wrecked boat with valuables and a letter to Bonnie MacFarlane.
- Wild Man (raised by wolves in Roanoke Ridge): after two meetings, follow him to his den for minor loot; killing him or the wolves in his den -2.
- Wilderness Hanging: a hanged man; nothing happens or the local gang ambushes you.

topics.title: Town chance encounters
topics.text:
- Beggar: give money +5; steal his money -5; kill -10; beat -5. One variant is a con man (get your donation back without penalty); another gives special snake oil.
- Bronte's Goons and Bronte Patrol (Saint Denis): fights get noticed, so watch for witnesses.
- Consequence: someone you saved from a trap or snake bite rewards you with one free item from a specific store (pick something expensive); +5 when thanked; killing them or their friend -20.
- Dark Alley Ambush (Saint Denis): you wake up in the cemetery or by the river.
- Dark Alley Stabbing: save the man +10; watch -5; leave -5; save then murder -20.
- Dead Bodies (Armadillo, Epilogue): killing the man who warns about cholera -10.
- Del Lobo Breakout (Epilogue): standing by while they kill the lawman -5. Del Lobo Execution (Epilogue): freeing the Del Lobo -2.
- Domestic Dispute: encourage either side +2; kill one -10; antagonize -2.
- Drowning Murder: save the woman +10 (knocking the man out can lead to a Public Hanging); watch her die -20; ignore -5; watch her escape -5.
- Drunk Dueler: decline and ignore the insults +5; disarm and spare +2; kill him after Chapter 5 -2. Sometimes he collapses first.
- Duel Boaster (Rhodes saloon) and Duel Winner: disarm and spare +2; kill -2.
- Fleeing Family (Armadillo, Epilogue): kill either -10; terrorize -5.
- Foot Robbery: intervene +5; watch -5. Gang Encounter: watch for witnesses if it turns violent.
- Intimidation Tactics (Saint Denis): nothing special.
- Lost Dog: return it +10; kill the boy or dog -20; if the boy is cruel, beating him +2, killing him -2.
- Lost Drunk: help +2; mislead -2; mislead and watch the result -10; kill him while passed out -20.
- On the Run (Strawberry): the swindler hides in the latrine across the river. Mislead the angry man and return +2; help him and watch the swindler die -5.
- Parlor Ambush (Rhodes saloon): leave or fight. Peeping Tom: scold the voyeurs +2; look -2; keep watching -10.
- Pickpocket: chase him for your money. Piss Pot (Saint Denis), Police Chase, Street Fight, Show Off: nothing special.
- Public Hanging: freeing the criminal -5, another -5 if you arrested him, and more for lawmen killed.
- Rat Infestation (Saint Denis slum saloon): help +5; shoot up the saloon and bail -5.
- Self Defense (Valentine, twice): first time, turn her in +2, help her after Chapter 5 -5, take the money then turn her in -5; second time, turn her in +2, help -2.
- Slum Ambush (Saint Denis): kill her before knowing it's a trap -5; following her from Epilogue 1 -5.
- Taunting: chase the youths into an ambush. Town Burial: jump in the grave -2; kill the reverend or a mourner -10.
- Town Confrontation: kill him -5.
- Town Robbery (Valentine): the money is in the top dresser drawer of room 1B (a fistfight follows). Lie about not finding it -5, and he attacks you later.
- Town Terror (Armadillo, Epilogue): intervene +2. Town Widow: give her money +5; kill -10; antagonize -2.
- Unpaid Debt: help the debtor +5; watch him get shot -5 (some variants).
- Wealthy Couple: save them +10; watch -5; watch the woman die -10; save then kill -20.

topics.title: Special characters (overview)
topics.text: Special characters have unique conversations, often over several stages days apart; how you treat them early changes later meetings (intimidate one and they may flee next time). Their locations are on the map on page 229.

topics.title: Agnes Dowd (bayou ghost)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 9pm-3am, in the bayou swamp. Six stages, each at a set spot, 48 in-game hours apart, with sub-stages where she's sometimes visible and sometimes not. Visible in 1c, 2b, 3b, 4b, 4d, 5b, 5d and 6; invisible in 1a, 1b, 2a, 3a, 4a, 4c, 5a and 5c.

topics.title: Anders Helgerson (Chelonian recruiter)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-6pm, in Saint Denis. He recruits for the Chelonian cult and gives you a pamphlet if you talk to him.

topics.title: Armadillo Town Crier
topics.text: Epilogue 1 onward, 8am-7pm, at two spots in Armadillo. He warns of a cholera outbreak.

topics.title: Blind Man Cassidy
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, many possible locations (see map), any time. Pay a dollar for a fortune. 18 stages up to the end of Chapter 6 (wait three in-game days between them), and eight more in the Epilogue.

topics.title: Cave Hermit
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. Lives deep in a dark cave directly west of Hanging Dog Ranch, at the map's edge. Five stages, 3+ in-game days apart. Stay around even after he tells you to leave so you hear everything and actually see him.

topics.title: Chelonian Master
topics.text: After you finish Epilogue 2. The turtle cult's leader jumps off a cliff with his followers: the same cliff where you rescue Jamie in We Loved Once and True.

topics.title: Captain Russell
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. A forgetful old Union soldier with three stages (3 in-game days apart), plus two more from Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Constipated Man
topics.text: After Polite Society, Valentine Style (Chapter 2). You can hear him struggling in room 2A of the Valentine hotel.

topics.title: Dorothea (suffragette)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-6pm, in Saint Denis, campaigning for women's votes. A second stage if you return at least one in-game day later.

topics.title: Dr MacIntosh
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, in Annesburg. Accept his book and return 3+ in-game days later for a second talk.

topics.title: Eugenics Proponent
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-6pm, on a Saint Denis street corner. Taking his pamphlet triggers a cutscene; after that he runs from you (from one in-game day later).

topics.title: Gavin's Friend
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. He appears at the Rhodes saloon (not while No Good Deed is open), Roanoke Ridge and Saint Denis, plus Blackwater, Tall Trees, MacFarlane's Ranch and east of Armadillo from Epilogue 1. He's looking for his friend Gavin. Looting him (preferably not in town) gives the Letter to Nigel from Tom, which explains the story.

topics.title: Giant
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-6pm, north of O'Creagh's Run. First study at least 30 animal species. Then, on a clear day (not rain, snow, storm or fog), go to the west bank of the river directly east of the Wapiti Indian Reservation, follow the unusual flock of birds on horseback to the giant's den. Two conversations, 3+ days apart.

topics.title: Hermit (rare shotgun)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, in a cabin north of Annesburg. He shoots trespassers on sight. Take him out to loot the house, including a secret treasure map (page 344), and his rare shotgun.

topics.title: Homeless Vet Mickey
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, begging at two spots in Valentine. Six stages, 3 in-game days apart, plus a seventh from Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Joe Butler
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. A one-legged former Confederate soldier begging outside the Rhodes general store. Three stages, 3 days apart, plus a fourth from Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Jon (raccoon hat)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 12pm-6am, ranting in Valentine's Smithfields saloon. Stay close and he eventually attacks; knock him out to take his classic raccoon mountain hat.

topics.title: Lillian Powell
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 9am-9pm, in the Saint Denis saloon: a drunk, aging writer. Four stages, 3 days apart.

topics.title: Mad Preacher
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, in rivers, 3+ days apart: first northwest of Strawberry, then west of Annesburg, then west of Valentine. A fourth stage southwest of Tumbleweed after the Epilogue.

topics.title: Nicholas Timmins (Strawberry mayor)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-8pm. The mayor of Strawberry greets visitors. Three stages, 2+ days apart: two at the Welcome Center, the third on the main street.

topics.title: Poor Joe
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. A hermit living in a tree north of Annesburg near the map's edge. Three stages, 3+ days apart; the last needs Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Reverend (Strawberry preacher)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, 8am-7pm, on a roadside in Strawberry. A second meeting 24+ hours later; your first answer changes it but has no gameplay effect.

topics.title: Robot
topics.text: After A Bright Bouncing Boy II. A robot appears on a mountaintop near Colter. The electric lantern (from the lab after that mission) glows orange when pointed toward it.

topics.title: Sonny (bayou cabin)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, in a cabin in Bayou Nwa a short way southeast of Lakay. Accept his invitation inside and you wake up in the wilderness, poorer and with drained cores. Come back for revenge: there's loot inside.

topics.title: Soothsayer
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward. A nearly blind fortune teller. 15 stages, 3 days apart, alternating between the bayou and Bluewater Marsh: ten in Chapters 2-6, five from Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Sun Worshipper
topics.text: Epilogue 1 onward, around New Austin. 12 meetings, 3+ days apart: three in Hennigan's Stead, one in Cholla Springs, five in Rio Bravo, one in Gaptooth Ridge, then two more in Rio Bravo.

topics.title: Thomas Downes (orphanage collector)
topics.text: From the start of Chapter 2 until Sodom? Back to Gomorrah, opposite the Valentine stable, raising money for an orphanage. One conversation before Americans at Rest and a different one after.

topics.title: Timothy Donahue (Get Rich Quick)
topics.text: Chapter 2 onward, near the Saint Denis barber, selling the book Get Rich Quick for $50. Come back 2+ days later to ask for a refund; you'll have to chase and loot him to get it (mind witnesses).

topics.title: Tumbleweed Sheriff
topics.text: Epilogue 1 onward. Tumbleweed's harsh sheriff; three encounters, each at least a day apart.

sections.title: Exploration
sections.intro: Everything outside the main story: horses, travel, camp, hunting, fishing, attributes, honor, challenges, the law, robberies, bounties, strangers, treasure, collectibles, gangs, table games, random encounters and special characters.

topics.title: Alligator
topics.text:
Size group: Massive. For a perfect kill use poison or improved arrows, poison throwing knives, a rifle, sniper rifle or shotgun slugs (critical or fatal hit).
Where (from the guide's habitat map): Lemoyne swamps and bayou east of Flat Iron Lake.
Sell prices ($):
- Perfect / Good / Poor skin: 3.50 / 2.10 / 1.40
- Big Game Meat: 0.75
- Alligator Tooth: 0.40
- Perfect / Good / Poor carcass: 6.50 / 3.90 / 2.60
- Legendary Alligator Skin: 50.00
- Legendary Alligator Tooth: no price listed
Prices are base values: +25% where the species is rare in that region, skinned carcasses are worth 50% less, and Special/Ultimate Edition owners get +10%.

Sell prices ($):
- Woodpecker Feather: 0.30
- Flight Feather: 0.15
- Gamey Bird Meat: 0.25
- Perfect / Good / Poor carcass: 1.00 / 0.60 / 0.40
Prices are base values: +25% where the species is rare in that region, skinned carcasses are worth 50% less, and Special/Ultimate Edition owners get +10%.

sections.title: Animal Field Guide
sections.intro: Every huntable species in the guide's Animal Parts & Habitat pages: size group, best weapon for a perfect kill, where it lives and what every part sells for.

topics.title: Reading weapon stats
topics.text:
Six stats: damage per shot, range (lock-on and firing distance), fire rate, reload (time per bullet), accuracy (spread and reticle size) and condition (wear, which affects the others).
- White part of a bar: the current value; it shrinks with wear and exposure to water and mud.
- Grey part: untapped potential, reached with gunsmith components (e.g. long barrel, improved rifling) or special ammo (express cartridges, for instance, raise damage). With the right setup the white can fill the grey.
- Black part: beyond that weapon's limit.
The compendium tracks every weapon you've found, with kills, headshots and accuracy.

topics.title: Weapon wear, cleaning and worn weapons
topics.text:
Wear lowers damage and fire rate and slows cocking and reloading. Three hidden causes:
- Soot from firing. Shots from perfect to worst: revolver 300, pistol 200, repeater 300, rifle/sniper 200, shotgun 150.
- Rust from water or deep snow, and dirt from deep mud (even holstered): 300 seconds from perfect to worst for every weapon type.
Watch the condition bar in the weapon wheel. Stow favorite guns on your horse before swimming or slogging through mud, and carry a spare sidearm.
Wear reducers (they stack): weapon wrap -10% (gunsmith; repeaters, rifles, shotguns); upgraded holster -20% (gunsmith, or the trapper's reinforced version after the challenge); reinforced off-hand holster -10%; Beaver Tooth trinket -10% (fence, from the legendary beaver tooth); Raven Claw talisman -20% (needs the Geology for Beginners reward); Legend of the East outfit -10% (all challenges).
Cleaning: inspect the weapon in the wheel (red segments show wear) and use gun oil (sold by gunsmiths, general stores, trappers and fences, and often found). Or pay a gunsmith. Gunsmiths can only customize a perfectly clean gun.
Worn weapons: guns picked up from enemies with the 'worn' prefix can never be fully restored; cleaning caps out below full.

topics.title: Ammunition, arrows and throwables
topics.text:
Cartridges (most pistols, revolvers, repeaters, rifles, sniper rifles):
- Regular: standard (bought).
- High velocity: damage +5, range +10 (bought).
- Split point: damage +5, accuracy +10 (crafted: regular cartridge + hunting knife).
- Express: damage +15 (bought).
- Explosive: damage +25 and explosive effect (crafted: express cartridge + animal fat).
- Varmint: for the Varmint Rifle only (bought).
Shotgun shells: regular (bought); slug, range +5 and accuracy +20 (bought); incendiary buckshot (crafted: regular shell + moonshine); explosive slug, damage +25, range +5, accuracy +20, explosive (crafted: shell + animal fat).
Arrows: standard; improved, damage +15 (arrow + flight feather); small game, damage -20 for clean small kills (arrow + regular shotgun shell + flight feather); poison, damage +5 (arrow + oleander sage + flight feather); fire, damage +20 and sets things alight (arrow + animal fat + flight feather); dynamite, damage +40 and explodes (arrow + dynamite + flight feather).
Throwables:
- Dynamite: light it in hand and throw, or plant it and shoot it. Volatile dynamite, damage +10 (bought or crafted: dynamite + animal fat + high-velocity cartridge).
- Fire bottle: sets an area ablaze (bought or crafted: any alcohol + animal fat). Volatile fire bottle, damage +10 (moonshine + animal fat).
- Throwing knife (bought); improved, damage +10, range +5, accuracy +5 (+ eagle or hawk feather); poison, damage +10 (+ oleander sage).
- Tomahawk (bought); improved, damage +10, range +5 (+ eagle or hawk feather); homing, range +5, accuracy +10 (+ owl feather); Ancient Tomahawk, a unique look, stuck in a broken target on the east side of Calumet Ravine, east of the Wapiti Indian Reservation.

topics.title: Gunsmiths: weapons, ammo and accessories with prices
topics.text:
Gunsmiths are in Valentine, Rhodes, Saint Denis and Annesburg, plus Tumbleweed from Epilogue 1. They clean guns, sell weapons, ammo and parts, and customize.
Weapons at every gunsmith (price, unlocked by completing):
- Cattleman Revolver $50 (Outlaws from the West). Carbine Repeater $90 (Old Friends). Volcanic Pistol $150, Springfield Rifle $120 and Varmint Rifle $72 (Eastward Bound). Sawed-Off Shotgun $85 (Enter, Pursued by a Memory).
- Double-Barreled Shotgun $95 (Paying a Social Call). Pump-Action Shotgun $148 (Pouring Forth Oil). Double-Action Revolver $65 (A Strange Kindness). Lancaster Repeater $135 (An American Pastoral Scene). Rolling Block Rifle $187 (The Sheep and the Goats). Schofield Revolver $84 (Blessed are the Meek?).
- Bolt Action Rifle $180 (Preaching Forgiveness as He Went). Semi-Auto Shotgun $225 (A Fine Night of Debauchery). Repeating Shotgun $185 (Visiting Hours). Litchfield Repeater $145 and Carcano Rifle $190 (Goodbye, Dear Friend).
Valentine and Saint Denis only: Semi-Automatic Pistol $210 (The Joys of Civilization); Mauser Pistol $250 (That's Murfree Country).
Ammo: arrows $0.50. Pistol: regular $1.00, express $1.50, high velocity $2.50. Repeater: $1.50 / $2.00 / $2.50. Revolver: $1.00 / $1.50 / $2.00. Rifle: varmint $1.00, regular $1.50, express $2.00, high velocity $3.00. Shotgun: regular $1.00, slug $1.50.
Accessories: gun oil $1.50; Upgraded Bandolier $69.50 (+50% longarm ammo); Upgraded Gun Belt $58.00 (+50% sidearm ammo); Upgraded Holster $45.50 (-20% wear on all weapons). Worth buying early.

topics.title: Weapons and ammo at general stores, fences and the trapper
topics.text:
Strawberry and Blackwater general stores: high-velocity pistol $2.50, repeater $2.50, revolver $2.00 and rifle $3.00 cartridges (pistol and rifle need Eastward Bound).
Strawberry only: express pistol $1.50, repeater $2.00, revolver $1.50, rifle $2.00 cartridges; slugs $1.50. Guns: Double-Action Revolver $65 (A Strange Kindness), Semi-Auto Shotgun $225 (A Fine Night of Debauchery), Rolling Block Rifle $187 (The Sheep and the Goats).
Blackwater only: Litchfield Repeater $145 (Goodbye, Dear Friend), Schofield Revolver $84 (Blessed are the Meek?), Pump-Action Shotgun $148 (Pouring Forth Oil).
All fences: dynamite $1.00 (Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?), throwing knife $2.50 (Paying a Social Call), tomahawk $4.00 (Americans at Rest), fire bottle $0.75 (The Fine Joys of Tobacco), hatchet $4.25, cleaver $8.00 and machete $10.00 (all Dear Uncle Tacitus).
Trapper: throwing knife $2.50 (Paying a Social Call), tomahawk $4.00 (Americans at Rest).

topics.title: Weapon customization: components and their effects
topics.text:
Gunsmiths apply components (which change performance) and styles (cosmetic). The gun must be clean first.
Components:
- Barrel length (revolvers, pistols, shotguns except the sawed-off): long barrel narrows the cone of fire for better accuracy. All start short except the Schofield, which comes long. Sidearm long barrel $12.
- Rifling: improved rifling adds 10% range and 10% to damage fall-off distance; on buckshot shotguns it widens the spread (less accurate). Longarm $20, sidearm $15.
- Iron sights (all but sniper rifles): improved sights for easier target acquisition, $5. In first person, toggle the sights view.
- Scopes (repeaters and rifles): short, medium or long zoom. Repeaters short $15; rifles short $15, medium $20; sniper rifles medium $15, long $25 (sniper rifles can't go scopeless).
- Wrap (repeaters, rifles, shotguns including the sawed-off): -10% wear, stacks, $10.
- Stock grain (longarms): basic, straight $14, wide $20 (wide is $12 on the sawed-off).
- Grips (revolvers and pistols): basic, ironwood, ebony, pearl ($12-$15). Hero Pearl Grip ($30): Cattleman only, needs honor rank 4 or higher. Gunslinger Ebony Grip ($30): Double-Action only, needs honor rank -4 or lower.
Styles: metals (iron, nickel, blued, blackened or browned steel, brass, silver, gold) for each part; engravings (Baroque, Art Nouveau, Victorian, Ornamental) with inlay metals; carved grips (rattlesnake, scorpion, puma, deer, eagle, buck on sidearms; scenes like buck, wolf, eagle, ram, flying eagle, bear on longarms); and many wood varnishes. Per-part prices are listed on pages 290-291. On the Double-Action Revolver, gold is only for players who finished its GTA Online treasure hunt.

topics.title: Unique and rare weapons: where to get them
topics.text:
Uniques can't be customized. Gunslinger weapons are missable: if you don't pick them up after the duel, they're gone.
- Flaco's Revolver: by Flaco Hernández's body after your duel.
- Granger's Revolver: by Emmet Granger's body after your duel.
- Calloway's Revolver: by your opponent's body after the final Noblest of Men, and a Woman duel.
- Midnight's Pistol: by Billy Midnight's body after the duel.
- Algernon's Revolver: final reward for Duchesses and Other Animals.
- Micah's Revolver: after American Venom, return to the final shootout spot on top of Mount Hagen and take it from the frozen body.
- Otis Miller's Revolver: in a hard-to-find chest in the north of Cholla Springs; two secret treasure maps lead to it (page 341).
- Rare Shotgun: dropped by the Hermit north of Annesburg when you kill him.
- Rare Rolling Block Rifle: dropped by the barn sniper at the end of Magicians for Sport.
- Bow: given at the start of The Aftermath of Genesis.
- Ancient Tomahawk: in a broken target on the east side of Calumet Ravine, east of the Wapiti Indian Reservation.
Knives and blades:
- Hunting Knife: from the start. Jawbone Knife: final reward for A Test of Faith.
- Wide-Blade Knife: on a body deep in Beryl's Dream mine, directly west of Mount Shann; use the plunger at the entrance to blast the rocks.
- Civil War Knife: on a crate in the basement of Fort Brennand, an abandoned fort southwest of Van Horn.
- Antler Knife: on a dead bear a short way northwest of Hanging Dog Ranch.
- Broken Pirate Sword: in a wrecked boat on the small islands directly south of Saint Denis's southern bridge.
- Machete, hatchet and cleaver: fences, after Dear Uncle Tacitus.
Hatchets in tree stumps:
- Double Bit Hatchet: northwest of Wallace Station.
- Rusted Double Bit Hatchet: in Annesburg, a short walk north of the coal mining facility.
- Hewing Hatchet: on the south shore of Moonstone Pond.
- Hunter Hatchet: directly south of Window Rock.
- Rusted Hunter Hatchet: outside a shack halfway between O'Creagh's Run and Elysian Pool.
- Viking Hatchet: in the old tomb a short way northeast of Beaver Hollow.
- Stone Hatchet: only for players who finished its GTA Online bounty mission; at the Native burial site just north of Owanjila.
Every weapon's stat bars are shown on pages 292-299.

topics.title: Where each standard weapon first becomes available
topics.text:
- Cattleman Revolver: in your inventory from the start.
- Double-Action Revolver: gunsmiths after A Strange Kindness; also found in Lonnie's Shack during Sean's Chapter 3 robbery. GTA Online treasure hunt finishers get a pre-modded one after Eastward Bound.
- Schofield Revolver: gunsmiths after Blessed are the Meek?; also in the Valentine doctor robbery.
- Volcanic Pistol: gunsmiths after Eastward Bound; free with the Special/Ultimate Edition.
- Semi-Automatic Pistol: Valentine and Saint Denis gunsmiths after The Joys of Civilization. Mauser Pistol: same shops after That's Murfree Country.
- Varmint Rifle: gunsmiths after Eastward Bound; free with the Special/Ultimate Edition. Springfield Rifle: gunsmiths after Eastward Bound. Bolt Action Rifle: given in Preaching Forgiveness as He Went.
- Carbine Repeater: given in Old Friends. Lancaster Repeater: supplied in An American Pastoral Scene. Litchfield Repeater: supplied in Goodbye, Dear Friend.
- Double-Barreled Shotgun: picked up at the end of Paying a Social Call. Sawed-Off Shotgun: given in Enter, Pursued by a Memory.
- Pump-Action Shotgun: gunsmiths after Pouring Forth Oil; also in the Chez Porter master bedroom; free with the Special/Ultimate Edition.
- Semi-Auto Shotgun: gunsmiths after A Fine Night of Debauchery; also in the Watson's Cabin basement.
- Repeating Shotgun: gunsmiths after Visiting Hours.
- Rolling Block Rifle: gunsmiths after Pouring Forth Oil; you must buy one in The Sheep and the Goats. Carcano Rifle: gunsmiths after Goodbye, Dear Friend.
- Throwing knives: fences and the trapper after Paying a Social Call. Tomahawk: after Americans at Rest. Fire bottle: fences after The Fine Joys of Tobacco. Dynamite: fences after Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?

sections.title: Weapons
sections.intro: How weapon stats and wear work, every type of ammunition, what each gunsmith, store and fence sells and when, customization prices, and where to find every unique weapon.

topics.title: Tonics: health cures, bitters, snake oil, miracle tonics
topics.text:
Meter values are in tanks; fortified temporarily boosts the attribute to level 10.
Health:
- Opened Health Cure: 10 (found).
- Health Cure: 10 + fortified 3 hrs (doctors, general stores, bait & tackle).
- Potent: fortified 6 hrs (doctors, crafted). Special: fortified 9 hrs (crafted).
Stamina:
- Opened Bitters: 10. Bitters: 10 + fortified 3 hrs (doctors, general stores).
- Potent: 6 hrs (doctors, crafted). Special: 9 hrs (crafted).
Dead Eye:
- Opened Snake Oil: 10. Snake Oil: 10 + fortified 3 hrs (doctors, fences, general stores).
- Potent: 6 hrs (doctors, fences, crafted). Special: 9 hrs (crafted).
All three meters:
- Opened Miracle Tonic: 10 each. Miracle Tonic: 10 + fortified 2 hrs each (doctors, general stores).
- Potent: 4 hrs (doctors, crafted). Special: 6 hrs (crafted).
Others:
- Moonshine: health +10 and fortified 3 hrs, health core -12% (fences).
- Cocaine Gum: stamina +10 and fortified 3 hrs, stamina core -12% (doctors, general stores, bait & tackle).
- Chewing Tobacco: Dead Eye +10 and fortified 3 hrs, stamina core -12% (general stores, doctors). Opened Tobacco: Dead Eye fortified 2 hrs.
- Aged Pirate Rum, Ginseng Elixir and Valerian Root give attribute XP instead (page 168).
Tonics have 1 calorie each (moonshine 3).

topics.title: Food and drink: canned goods, snacks, alcohol, fruit and berries
topics.text:
Core percentages restored (H health, S stamina, D Dead Eye core); most canned goods and snacks are about 3 calories.
- Canned strawberries H37 S37. Apricots H12 S37. Peaches H25 S37. Pineapples H50 S37. Corn H37 S25. Peas H37 S12. Baked beans H37 S37. Kidney beans H37 S50. Corned beef H50, D12. Canned salmon H50, D25.
- Salted offal H25, D25. Salted beef H25, D37. Salted venison H37, D37. Cheese wedge H37, D37. Classic oatcakes H25, D12. Bread roll H25. Bread chunk, crackers and almonds H12. Assorted biscuits H25. Candies S25, D12. Chocolate bar S50, D25 (5 calories).
- Cigarettes: stamina core -12%, D12. Cigar: stamina core -12%, D62. Coffee (crafted): S50, D50.
- Spirits: opened gin S12 D25; opened Guarma rum S12 D25; opened fine brandy S12 D37; opened bourbon H-12 S25 D37. Full bottles: gin S25 D50; Guarma rum S37 D50; fine brandy S25 D62; Kentucky bourbon H-12 S37 D62.
- Produce: apple H12 S25; peach H12 S25; pear H25 S25; beets H25 S25; carrot H25 S12; celery H12; corn H25; peppermint S12 D12; sugar cube S12.
- Wild: bay bolete, chanterelle, parasol mushroom, ram's head, blackberry, huckleberry, raspberry, wintergreen berry and wild carrots each give H12.

topics.title: Herbs: where they grow and what they do
topics.text:
- Sage: everywhere, e.g. both banks of the Kamassa River (S12).
- Burdock Root: western Great Plains, along the railway and riverbanks (S12).
- Ginseng: forests and damp areas (H12).
- Creeping Thyme: thin soil by riverbanks, sandy soil, near rocks (D12).
- Currant: foothills and streams in West Elizabeth and northeast New Hanover (D12).
- Indian Tobacco: woods and savannahs in West Elizabeth, Ambarino and Lemoyne (D12).
- Common Bulrush: by streams and lakes everywhere (H12).
- Oleander Sage: riverbanks of Bayou Nwa (poisonous: health -2 tanks, health core -25%; used for poison weapons).
- English Mace: riverbanks in Rio Bravo, New Austin (H12).
- Prairie Poppy: Great Plains, often near the tracks (D12).
- Milkweed: riverbanks of Bayou Nwa and Dewberry Creek (H12).
- Violet Snowdrop: northern Ambarino (S12).
- Oregano: dry grasslands (S12).
- Wild Mint: marshes, streams, damp meadows (H12).
- Vanilla Flower: Bayou Nwa riverbanks (H12).
- Yarrow: grasslands and open forest in New Hanover and Lemoyne (H12).
- Wild Feverfew: Cholla Springs (S12).
Ginseng, English mace, milkweed, vanilla flower and yarrow cure snake poison.

topics.title: Saloon meals and where to order them
topics.text:
- All saloons: beer (S12, D50) and whiskey (H-12, S12, D12).
- Valentine Keane's: oatmeal (50% all cores).
- Valentine Smithfields: beef stew (50% all); lamb's fry (health core 100% + gold for 1 day, other cores 100%).
- Saint Denis: prime rib (100% + gold health 1 day, others 100%); lobster bisque (75% all).
- Van Horn: lamb heart (100% + gold health 1 day); fish stew (75% all).
- Rhodes: fried catfish (100% + gold health 1 day); cracked wheat and milk (50% all).
- Tumbleweed: roast beef (100% + gold health 1 day); chilli (75% all).
- Blackwater: prairie chicken (100% + gold health 1 day); peach cobbler (75% all).
Most meals are 5 calories.

topics.title: Cooking: recipes, seasonings and camp stews
topics.text:
Cooking needs a campfire; every recipe but coffee uses meat. Add one herb to boost a core by 25%: thyme for Dead Eye, oregano for stamina, wild mint for health.
Base results (H/S/D core %; seasoning raises one to the next tier):
- Stringy meat, gritty fish, herptile, gamey bird: 37/37/37, can't be seasoned (1 calorie).
- Gristly mutton (goat, ram, sheep), plump bird (chicken, goose, turkey, rooster), crustacean (crab), flaky fish (most lake and river fish): 50/50/50 (3 calories).
- Prime beef (bison, bull, cow, ox), venison (buck, deer, elk, moose, pronghorn), pork (boar, peccary, pig), game (duck, pheasant, rabbit), succulent fish (sockeye salmon, steelhead trout), exotic bird (parakeet, parrot, pelican): 75/75/75, seasoned one goes to 100 (5 calories).
- Big game (alligator, bear, cougar, panther, wolf): 100/100/100 plain; seasoned adds a gold core for a day (10 calories).
Pearson's camp stew:
- Base stew H50. Low-quality meat H62. Medium H75. High quality: H100 + gold 1 day. Big game: H100 + gold 1.5 days.
- Eggs (chicken coop upgrade) add Dead Eye core: eggs only H50 D50; low meat + eggs 62/62; medium + eggs 75/75; high + egg 100 + gold 1 day on health and 1.5 days on Dead Eye; big game + eggs 100 + gold 1.5 days on both.

topics.title: Horse food, tonics and grooming items
topics.text:
Food: core restore (health/stamina) and bonding XP when the cores are low/medium/full.
- Horse Meal (crafted): 100% + gold 1 day on both; 15/5/1 XP.
- Carrot, hay, classic oatcakes, beets: 62/62; 15/5/1 XP.
- Wild carrots: 62 health; 15/5/1 XP.
- Corn 50/50; apple and peach 25/25; pear 25/25; celery 12/25; burdock root 25/12; oregano 25/12; ginseng 12/25.
- Mushrooms, herbs and berries (parasol, bay bolete, chanterelle, creeping thyme, wild mint, ram's head, blackberry, raspberry, wintergreen): 25 health; 5/5/1 XP.
- Treats: sugar cube 25 stamina; peppermint 12 stamina; currant, sage and feverfew 25 stamina; common bulrush and English mace 12.
Tonics: Horse Reviver (revives, +5 health); Special Horse Reviver (10 + gold health 1 day). Horse Medicine 10 + fortified 2 hrs; Potent 4 hrs; Special 10 hrs. Horse Stimulant 10 + fortified 2 hrs; Potent 4 hrs; Special 10 hrs. Sold at stables, general stores, doctors and the tackle shop (specials are crafted).
Grooming: Horse Brush (given in Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego; 15 bonding XP when the horse is dirty). Horse Ointment (crafted): health 50%, stamina 100% + gold 1 day. Horse Care Package (stables): both cores 100% + gold 1 day.

topics.title: Kit and tools
topics.text:
Special-purpose items:
- Ancient Arrowhead: stamina lasts twice as long while drawing the bow (cave behind the Elysian Pool waterfall after all 20 dreamcatchers).
- Bandana (after Outlaws from the West): hides your identity for crimes.
- Binoculars (after Outlaws from the West): scout and study targets at range.
- Cover Scent Lotion: animals detect you less (crafted, general stores, fences, tackle).
- Herbivore, predator, and potent baits: attract animals.
- Crafting tools (given by Hosea during Eastward Bound).
- Lock breaker (given in Friends in Very Low Places; fences): opens locks silently.
- Hair pomade and hair tonic (general stores): slick hair back; tonic doubles growth speed.
- Pocket watch: shows the time (general stores).
- Wardrobe: change outfits (from the start).
- Valuable keepsakes to sell: antique, gold, platinum, silver, Reutlinger pocket watches.
- Mission items include Beau's gift, Mary's brooch, Penelope's bracelet, Sister Calderón's crucifix, the lightning conductor and the pollution evidence.
Improved satchels come from Pearson (page 144), or from fences from Epilogue 1.

topics.title: Talismans and trinkets: permanent perks
topics.text:
Talismans and trinkets work as long as you own them; you don't equip them (show or hide talismans in the wardrobe). Crafted at fences.
Talismans (fence materials):
- Alligator Tooth: Dead Eye core drains 10% slower (Vintage Civil War Handcuffs, Gold Jointed Bracelet, Legendary Alligator Tooth). $40.
- Bear Claw: health core drains 10% slower (Silver Chain Bracelet, Quartz Chunk, Legendary Bear Claw). $34.75.
- Boar Tusk: horse's health and stamina cores drain 10% slower (Cobalt Petrified Wood, Gold Earring, Legendary Boar Tusk). $31.
- Bison Horn: stamina core drains 10% slower (Abalone Shell Fragment, Silver Earring, Legendary Bison Horn). $38.50.
- Raven Claw: weapon wear 20% slower (Old Brass Compass). $29.
- Eagle Talon: Eagle Eye lasts five seconds longer (Special/Ultimate Edition).
Trinkets (one legendary part each):
- Beaver Tooth: weapon wear 10% slower. Tatanka Bison Horn: 10% less melee damage. Buck Antler: better-quality parts when skinning.
- Cougar Fang: +10% stamina XP. Coyote Fang: +10% Dead Eye XP. Elk Antler: +10% money from looting. Fox Claw: Eagle Eye 5 seconds longer.
- Lion's Paw (He's British, of Course): +10% stamina XP. Moose Antler: +10% health XP.
- Panther's Eye: Dead Eye drains 10% slower for three seconds. Pronghorn Horn: carcasses on your horse don't spoil.
- Ram Horn: double the herbs from oregano, creeping thyme and wild mint. Wolf Heart: doubles your alcohol resistance.
- Owl Feather: all core drain 15% slower (Archeology for Beginners, no guard killed). Iguana Scale: 10% less damage on horseback (Special/Ultimate Edition).
Special materials:
- Vintage Civil War Handcuffs: first cigarette card set mailed.
- Lion's Paw: from the lion in He's British, of Course.
- Quartz Chunk: mail your first dinosaur bone.
- Cobalt Petrified Wood: chest under a rock overhang NW of Lake Isabella.
- Abalone Shell Fragment: old house just north of the Rhodes sheriff's office.
- Old Brass Compass: Francis Sinclair's cabin after all 10 rock carvings.

topics.title: Bandoliers, gun belts and holsters: upgraded and reinforced
topics.text:
- Bandolier: longarm ammo +50% upgraded (gunsmith $69.50), +100% reinforced.
- Gun belt: sidearm ammo +50% upgraded ($58.00), +100% reinforced.
- Holster: -20% weapon wear, upgraded ($45.50) or reinforced.
- Off-hand holster: -10% weapon wear (reinforced only).
Reinforced versions are sold by the trapper ($12.25-$34.75) once the matching challenge rank is done, for example Bandit Bandolier $21.75 (Bandit rank 1), Explorer Bandolier $34.75 (Explorer rank 3), Herbalist Bandolier $30.25 (Herbalist rank 10), Weapons Expert Holster $12.25 (Weapons Expert rank 1). Exact unlock ranks for every piece are in the challenge lists (page 172).

topics.title: Valuables: what to sell and where special ones come from
topics.text:
Mostly for selling at fences; some feed talisman crafting or encounters.
- Ammolite: bird's nest in the Grizzlies East, on a small ledge near the ridge (page 340). Fluorite: bird's nest in the Grizzlies East, small ledge near the ridge.
- Ancient Necklace: e.g. in the drawer under the black flower at Scratching Post.
- Broken Pistol and Fertility items: Compson's Stead (Iniquities of History II). Female Fertility Statue: lock box under the porch chair of the Roadside Brothel. Fertility Statue: in the chimney of the Old Bacchus Place, directly south of Thieves Landing.
- Catherine's Brooch: on Catherine at the burned Braithwaite Manor after Blood Feuds. Gold Shield: Braithwaite Manor mantelpiece downstairs during Blood Feuds.
- Deputy Star: American Distillation. Diamond Brooch: Gwyn Hughes loansharking. Emerald: He's British, of Course V. Gold Ingot: A Strange Kindness reward.
- Gold Earring: Watson's Cabin nightstand. Gold Nugget: e.g. Dodd's Bluff shack, or the whiskey bottles hanging in a tree west of Dewberry Creek. Gold Wedding Ring: on the black sheep north of Heartland Overflow, or in Lakay's southernmost cabin. Large Jewelry Bag: e.g. upstairs in the Chez Porter barn.
- Mary's Ring (letter after Goodbye, Dear Friend; can't be sold). Native American Ring: Drunk Camp encounter. Necklace: Torch Procession encounter. Pen: save Jimmy Brooks in Polite Society. Platinum Band: Fairvale Shanty lock box or the Scratching Post drawer.
- Silver Locket: recover J. John Weathers' debt. Silver Tooth: Voice encounter. Wedding Ring: Wealthy Couple or Torch Procession encounters. White Cougar Pelt: the Winton Holmes cougar.
- Rock Statue (5 carvings mailed), Skull Statue (15 bones mailed), Squirrel Statue (Ms Hobbs).
- Random loot: gold and silver bracelets, buckles, earrings, rings, necklaces, teeth; platinum items; jewelry boxes; small jewelry bags.

topics.title: Documents, newspapers and recipe pamphlets
topics.text:
Hundreds of letters, maps, photos and pamphlets (full A-Z list on pages 316-319). Some highlights:
- Free pamphlets at the start of Chapter 2: cover scent, express explosive, fire arrow, fire bottle, horse ointment, improved arrow, improved throwing knife, improved tomahawk, potent herbivore and predator bait, small game arrow, split point.
- Recipe pamphlets found in chests (most are also sold by fences after a mission): dynamite arrow, explosive slug, homing tomahawk, incendiary buckshot, poison arrow, poison throwing knife, special bitters, special health cure, special horse medicine, special horse reviver, special horse stimulant, special snake oil, special tonic, volatile dynamite, volatile fire bottle. Horse meal pamphlet: Kieran's request.
- Treasure maps: Jack Hall Gang, High Stakes, Le Trésor des Morts. Torn Treasure Map 1 & 2: in a drawer in the hermit woman's cabin near the source of Little Creek River, and with the hermit at Manito Glade north of Annesburg. Combined, they make the Mended Map. Otis Miller documents: Clawson's Rest, Osman Grove and Pleasance (they lead to Otis Miller's Revolver).
- Camp books (at camp): The American Inferno, The Case of the Deceitful German, The Castle Above the Glen and others.
Newspapers: Blackwater Ledger (Blackwater, Strawberry), New Hanover Gazette (Annesburg, Valentine), Saint Denis Times (Saint Denis, Rhodes). Fourteen editions, each released at a story milestone: Eastward Bound, Pouring Forth Oil, The Sheep and the Goats, Magicians for Sport, The Joys of Civilization, Urban Pleasures, Dear Uncle Tacitus, Visiting Hours, The Bridge to Nowhere, The King's Son, The Wheel, The Landowning Classes, Uncle's Bad Day, American Venom. They report your exploits and hint at people and places.

topics.title: Crafting recipes and where to find each pamphlet
topics.text:
Craft some items anywhere with crafting tools (rest, then open crafting, or use the item wheel), and more at a campfire. Many recipes need a pamphlet; those marked 'start' are given at the beginning of Chapter 2. Fences sell most of the others once unlocked.
On the go:
- Predator bait: stringy meat + a berry (no pamphlet).
- Potent herbivore bait: vanilla flower, violet snowdrop, a mushroom (start). Potent predator bait: gritty fish meat + a berry (start).
- Arrows: improved (+ flight feather), fire (+ animal fat + feather), small game (+ regular shotgun shell + feather): start. Poison (+ oleander + feather): chest outside the Mysterious Hill Home NE of Bacchus Station, or fences from Chapter 2. Dynamite (+ dynamite + feather): chest by a small bridge at the south end of the Wapiti Reservation, or fences after A Short Walk in a Pretty Town.
- Fire bottle (any spirit + animal fat): start. Volatile fire bottle (moonshine + fat): campsite chest in the burned forest NW of Horseshoe Overlook, or fences after Pouring Forth Oil. Volatile dynamite (dynamite + fat + high-velocity cartridge): chest under a broken wagon at Hani's Bethel, or fences after American Distillation.
- Homing tomahawk (+ owl feather): chest in Flattened Cabin south of Moonstone Pond, or fences from Chapter 2. Improved tomahawk and improved throwing knife (+ eagle or hawk feather): start. Poison throwing knife (+ oleander): under a floorboard in an oblong shack NE of Saint Denis, or fences after Pouring Forth Oil.
- Split point cartridge (hunting knife + regular cartridge) and explosive cartridge (express + fat): start. Incendiary buckshot (shell + moonshine): under a floorboard at Copperhead Landing, or fences after Pouring Forth Oil. Explosive slug (slug + fat): chest by an alchemist's burned house between Gaptooth Ridge and Cholla Springs, or fences after A Short Walk in a Pretty Town.
At a campfire:
- Potent horse medicine (ginseng + bulrush), potent horse stimulant (sage + bulrush): no pamphlet.
- Special horse medicine: Fort Brennand chest. Special horse reviver: tree stump east of Mattock Pond. Special horse stimulant: under a desk in the burned settlement SW of Horseshoe Overlook.
- Horse ointment (sage, bulrush, yarrow): start. Horse meal (currant x3, beets x3, hay x3): Kieran's burdock root request.
- Potent health cure (ginseng + yarrow), potent bitters (sage + burdock), potent snake oil (Indian tobacco), potent miracle tonic (Indian tobacco x4, ginseng x4, sage x4): no pamphlet.
- Special health cure: chest on the Face in Cliff scaffolding north of Moonstone Pond, or No Good Deed reward. Special bitters: crates just south of Owanjila Dam. Special snake oil: shack by the tracks east of Eris Field. Special miracle tonic: chest by a bloodstained tent NW of Mount Shann.
- Cover scent lotion (scent gland): start.
Pearson, the trapper and fences also craft items for you.

topics.title: General stores: key prices and exclusive outfits
topics.text:
General stores are in most towns (shop map on page 324). Prices are base values and change with honor discounts.
- Ammo: arrows $0.50, pistol $1.00, repeater $1.50, revolver $1.00, rifle $1.50, varmint $1.00, shotgun shells $1.00.
- Kit: coffee percolator $7.50, cover scent $1.25, gun oil $1.50, hair pomade $1.50, hair tonic $3.75, herbivore bait $2.25, lake lure $2.50, live crickets $0.50, live worms $0.50, pocket watch $15.50, predator bait $3.00.
- Food: apple $0.40, biscuits $2.00, baked beans $1.20, bread roll $0.40, candies $3.00, canned goods $0.75-$2.00, cheese $1.90, chocolate bar $2.00, cigar $1.50, cigarettes $3.50, oatcakes $4.00, coffee $1.00, gin $2.10, fine brandy $3.00, Guarma rum $2.50, Kentucky bourbon $3.75, premium cigarettes $5.00, salted beef $1.50.
- Tonics: bitters $3.00, chewing tobacco $6.00, cocaine gum $5.00, health cure $2.50, horse medicine $1.50, horse reviver $9.50, horse stimulant $2.50, miracle tonic $4.00, potent horse medicine $3.00, potent horse stimulant $4.00, snake oil $3.50.
- Clothing (not sold in the Saint Denis and Blackwater general stores): boots $13.75-$29, coats $10.50-$21, hats $5.50-$29.50, plus gloves, pants, shirts, spurs, suspenders and vests.
- Honor-locked outfits: Valentine sells the Valentine ($113.25, rank 3) and the Dewberry Creek ($115.50, rank 6). Rhodes sells the Chevalier ($98, rank 3) and the Gambler ($123.25, rank 6). Strawberry: the Cumberland ($105.75, rank 3) and the Faulkton ($84.50, rank 6). Wallace Station: the Roscoe ($95.25, rank 3) and the Drover ($90.25, rank 6). Tumbleweed: the Cowpuncher ($107.75, rank 3) and the Drifter ($88.75, rank 6). Armadillo: the Bulldogger ($79.50, rank 3) and the Scrapper ($71.50, rank 6). Each shop also has two unrestricted outfits.

topics.title: Barbers, butchers, fences, stables, doctors, bait shop, tailors, trapper
topics.text:
- Barbers (Valentine, Saint Denis, Blackwater): trims and styles from $0.25; pomade $1.00; Extra Clean Shaven needs A Fine Night of Debauchery.
- Butchers (Valentine, Strawberry, Rhodes, Saint Denis, Blackwater, Tumbleweed): buy carcasses and sell salted beef $1.50, salted venison $1.80, venison, prime beef and pork loin $5.50. Do Pearson's upgrades before selling perfect parts.
- Fences (unlocked after The Spines of America): dynamite, throwables, recipe pamphlets ($55-$90), Jack Hall and High Stakes maps ($1), baits, lock breaker $25, gun oil, snake oil, talisman and trinket crafting ($16-$40), masks, moonshine, and from Epilogue 1 all satchels ($15-$29 each, Legend of the East $150 once you own the rest). The wagon fence is at Emerald Ranch. The horse fence just north of Clemens Point opens after Horse Flesh for Dinner.
- Stables: horse food, tonics (horse medicine $1.50, reviver $9.50), care package $5, retrieving your horse $0-$10, saddles $39-$85 (upgrades raise stamina and health core regen), saddlebags (upgraded holds more and doubles carcass storage), horns, blankets, stirrups, manes and tails.
- Doctors (Valentine and Saint Denis): all tonics and remedies, plus candies and chocolate.
- Bait & Tackle (west shore of Lagras): baits, lures (special lures $20 after triggering A Fisher of Fish), horse remedies, crackers, oatcakes.
- Tailors (Saint Denis and Blackwater): the widest clothing range, with exclusive outfits (Saint Denis: the Corson at honor rank 3, the Deauville at rank 6; Blackwater: the McLaughlin at rank 3, the Farrier at rank 6).
- Trapper (Saint Denis, plus four wilderness stalls): crafts boots, chaps, coats, gloves, hats, vests and saddles from perfect and legendary pelts (e.g. Legendary Bear Coat $28, Rattlesnake Vaquero Saddle $120). Sells the reinforced challenge gear, and the garments made from all pieces of each outfit set.

topics.title: Trophies and achievements: story and completion
topics.text:
Main story accolades:
- Back in the Mud (bronze, 20G): complete Chapter 1.
- Just a Scratch (bronze, 10G): complete Enter, Pursued by a Memory.
- To Greener Pastures (bronze, 20G): complete Chapter 2.
- Settling Feuds (bronze, 20G): complete Chapter 3.
- Washed Ashore (bronze, 20G): complete Chapter 4.
- No Traitors (bronze, 20G): complete Chapter 5.
- Third Time Lucky (bronze, 10G): complete Goodbye, Dear Friend.
- Redemption (silver, 30G): complete Red Dead Redemption.
- Cowboy Builder (bronze, 10G): complete A New Jerusalem.
- Endless Summer (gold, 20G): complete Epilogue 2.
- Lending a Hand (silver, 30G): every optional honor mission: We Loved Once and True I-III, Good, Honest, Snake Oil, The Course of True Love I-V, Money Lending and Other Sins I-VII, Help a Brother Out, Brothers and Sisters, One and All, Fatherhood and Other Dreams I & II, Do Not Seek Absolution I & II, Archeology for Beginners, Honor, Amongst Thieves, Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow I & II.
- Gold Rush (silver, 50G): 70 gold medals in story missions (page 30).
Top accolades:
- Best in the West (gold, 100G): 100% completion (page 334).
- Legend of the West (platinum, PS4 only): every other trophy.

topics.title: Trophies and achievements: activities and challenges
topics.text:
- Western Stranger (bronze, 30G): complete 10 stranger mission strands (page 186).
- Artificial Intelligence: discover the fate of Marko Dragic (A Bright Bouncing Boy).
- Friends with Benefits: a companion activity at Horseshoe Overlook, Clemens Point and Shady Belle.
- Hobby Horse: play every table game.
- It's Art: after Epilogue 2 and Ms Hobbs's squirrel statue, put the statue on the shelf above the living room mantelpiece at Beecher's Hope. Someone keeps moving it; put it back each time until they give in.
- Breaking and Entering: recover four homestead stashes.
- Collector's Item: finish any special collectible mission (cigarette cards, exotics, dinosaur bones, rock carvings, etc.).
- Errand Boy: five item requests (time-sensitive, mostly Chapters 2-4).
- Take From the Rich: rob or loot $250.
- Give to the Poor: donate $250 to the tithing box before Banking, the Old American Art (Chapter 4).
- Pony Up: spend $5,000 in shops.
- Extreme Personality: reach honor rank 8 or -8 (only possible after Paradise Mercifully Departed; Chapter 6's 1.5x honor multiplier helps).
- Bountiful: survive three days with a $250 bounty in every state (New Austin from Epilogue 1); stay out of towns and off busy roads.
- Paying Respects: find the graves of all fallen companions (page 346).
- Self Sufficient: craft 30 unique items.
- Skin Deep: skin every animal species.
- Zoologist: study every animal in all states (focus or use binoculars, then study).
- It Was THIS Big!: catch a fish of at least 16 lbs.
- Locked and Loaded: upgrade every component on one sidearm or longarm.
- Grin and Bear It: survive 18 bear attacks, killing the bear each time; you must be grappled and shoot it during the struggle.
- Trusty Steed: bonding level 4 with a horse.

topics.title: 100% total completion requirements
topics.text:
Track progress under Progress in the pause menu.
Missions:
- All 107 story missions.
- 10 stranger strands (page 186).
- 5 bounties (page 184).
- 25 chance encounters (page 223).
- Survive a gang ambush and clear all gang hideouts (page 218).
Collectibles:
- One point of interest (page 338) and the nine companion graves (page 346).
- A full cigarette card set (page 199).
- A Test of Faith (page 208), A Fisher of Fish (page 164), Duchesses and Other Animals (page 206), Geology for Beginners (page 210), A Better World, A New Friend (page 212).
- One treasure hunt chain (page 196) and all 20 dreamcatchers (page 212).
Compendium: 50 animals studied, 10 equipment items, 10 fish species, all gangs, 10 horse breeds, 20 plant species, 48 weapons.
Player: max health, stamina and Dead Eye (page 167); bonding level 4 (page 140); every challenge (page 172).
Miscellaneous:
- 5 shacks, 5 legendary animals, each table game once, 5 special characters.
- Take a bath at a hotel; see a show (e.g. the pavilion near the Valentine stable); see a live performance at the Théâtre Raleur in Saint Denis.
- Craft one item from six categories: a cooked meal, a tonic, ammo, a hunting item, a horse care item and a throwable.
- Do a home robbery, a shop robbery, a coach robbery and a train robbery.

topics.title: The compendium: what it tracks
topics.text:
Under Progress in the pause menu. Every entry is listed on pages 334-336.
- Animals: every subspecies counts separately, e.g. whitetail buck and deer, grizzly and black bear, many birds, snakes (boas, rattlesnakes, copperheads, cottonmouth, water snakes), dog breeds (including Rufus), the donkey, and all 16 legendary animals.
- Equipment: lasso, binoculars, fishing rod, electric and old lanterns, camera, upgraded and reinforced belts and holsters, all satchels, every talisman and trinket.
- Fish: 15 species plus 14 legendary fish.
- Gangs: Lemoyne Raiders, O'Driscoll Boys, Murfree Brood, Skinner Brothers, Laramie Gang, Del Lobos.
- Plants: 30 herbs and 13 orchids.
- Horses: 19 breeds (American Paint through Turkoman, including Belgian Draft, Shire and Suffolk Punch).
- Weapons: every revolver, pistol, repeater, rifle, shotgun, bow, throwable and melee weapon, including John's Cattleman Revolver, John's Knife, the Ornate Dagger and all eight hatchets.
- Cigarette cards: all 144 by set.

topics.title: Points of interest (sketchable landmarks)
topics.text:
Inspect one of these to make Arthur sketch it in his journal; finding one counts toward 100%. Atlas numbers 201-249:
201 Abandoned Church, 202 Oil Derrick, 203 Abandoned Trading Post, 204 Barrel Rider, 205 Native Burial, 206 Circus Wagons, 207 Bolger Glade, 208 Crashed Airship, 209 Defaced Grave, 210 Donkey Lady, 211 Face in Cliff, 212 Faces in Trees, 213 Flying Machine, 214 Fossilized Man, 215 Manmade Mutant, 216 Frozen Settler (take the morion helmet from the body), 217 Giant Remains, 218 Grays' Secret, 219 Withered Arm, 220 Hermit Woman, 221 Hidden Tunnel, 222 Jesuit Missionary, 223 Mammoth, 224 Meditating Monk, 225 Meteorite, 226 Obelisk, 227 Old World Scripts, 228 Tiny Church, 229 Pagan Ritual (take the Ram Skull Mask from the body), 230 Phonograph, 231 Serpent Mound, 232 Sperm Whale Bones, 233 Old Tomb (the Viking Hatchet by the altar, and the Ancient Viking Comb behind skulls you can shoot), 234 Strange Statues (cave reached through a crevice in the granite), 235 Strange Statues (cave painting under a rock overhang), 236 Trading Post, 237-240 Trail Trees I-IV, 241 Wickiup, 242 Mysterious Hill Home, 243 Warped Tree, 244 Whale Bones, 245 Braithwaites' Secret, 246 Brush Fire, 247 Meteor House, 248 Register Rock, 249 Pleasance.

topics.title: Shacks and cabins with secrets
topics.text:
Each hides a small story, usually with loot such as valuables, cards or special tonics. Find five for 100%. For example, at Robard Farm two bodies lie inside, and a third, seen through the window, carries a letter that explains them.
Shacks (atlas *1-*19): 1 Dormin Crest Shack, 2 Fairvale Shanty, 3 Snowfield Shack, 4 Dodd's Bluff Cabin, 5 Clawson's Rest Shack, 6 Martha's Swain Cabin, 7 Hani's Bethel, 8 Vetter's Echo Cabin, 9 Shepherd's Rise Cabin (Epilogue), 10 Ridge View Cabin (Epilogue), 11 Osman Grove Cabin, 12 Lenora View Cabin, 13 Old Trail Rise Shack, 14 Robard Farm, 15 Bayall Edge Shack, 16 Bear Claw Shack, 17 Argil Rise Cabin (Epilogue), 18 Crawdad Willies Shack, 19 Old Harry Fen Shack.

topics.title: Unique collectibles: hats, masks, maps and more
topics.text:
Fixed, one-of-a-kind items (map on page 341):
- Hewing Hatchet: tree stump on Moonstone Pond's south shore.
- Black Sheep: near the railroad just north of Heartland Overflow, wearing a gold wedding ring.
- Cat Skull Mask: at the back of a half-collapsed shack.
- Civil War Hat and Civil War Knife: the old fort's basement (Fort Brennand).
- Meteorite: inside the meteor house west of Brandywine Drop. It cuts the effects of hot weather by 10%.
- Tricorn Hat: inside the shipwreck on Flat Iron Lake's largest island.
- Ram Skull Mask: hanging from a pillar of the abandoned pergola (Pagan Ritual site).
- Nevada Hat: behind the waterfall at Granite Pass.
- Torn treasure maps: one in a drawer in the hermit's shack, one in a side-table drawer in the Manito Glade cabin.
- Viking Helmet: inside the old tomb.
- Otis Miller documents: Osman Grove, Clawson's Rest, Pleasance schoolhouse, plus Wild West Heroes (Downes Ranch) and True Tales of Frank Heck (Lake Don Julio).
- Wide-Blade Knife, Antler Knife, Broken Pirate Sword, Stone Hatchet: see unique weapons.
- Abalone Shell Fragment: an old house a few steps north of the Rhodes sheriff's office.
Otis Miller's Treasure (Epilogue 1 onward): the two torn maps lead to Rattlesnake Hollow, a small cave in northern Cholla Springs. Go straight west from Twin Rocks to near the state border. The chest holds Otis Miller's Revolver among other prizes.

topics.title: Event areas: places that change over time
topics.text:
These sites develop in stages as you revisit them; help (and don't antagonize) the contact to move them along. All reach their final stage at Epilogue 1.
Appleseed Timber Co. (northeast of Strawberry):
- Stage 1: lumberjacks clearing the forest. Sell the foreman food and medicine.
- Stage 2: an accident. Lift the tree off the trapped man (honor), then give him money for more honor.
- Stage 3: wolves killed two workers. Follow the trail south with Eagle Eye, kill the wolves and collect a reward.
- Stage 4: the forest is gone; by the Epilogue nature has taken the camp back.
Castor's Ridge (southwest of Valentine), a father and two sons building a cabin:
- Stage 1: foundations.
- Stage 2: drive off a protection-racket gang (honor).
- Stage 3: lend the father $100.
- Stage 4: he sells the house and repays you $150.
- Stage 5: the new family has a vegetable garden.
Central Union Railroad Camp (between Emerald Station and Van Horn):
- Stage 1: help senior foreman Percy Whitsickle. Tail the junior foreman to a tree hiding stolen money and confront him. Return the money; bringing the hogtied junior foreman too triggers a special conversation.
- Stage 2: near Elysian Pool, Cornwall's men block the land. Dead Eye the leader to scare off the other two and return the property deed.
- Stage 3: help yourself to leftover supplies in the southeast tent.
- Stage 4: the line is finished and the camp is gone.

topics.title: The Poisonous Trail treasure (secret)
topics.text:
A secret treasure with no in-game clue, available from Chapter 2.
- Map 1: on the outskirts of Cairn Lake, just southeast of Colter.
- Map 2: in Scarlett Meadows just west of Ringneck Creek, a rocky outcrop shaped like a human face. Behind the hill, in a hollow at the foot of a tree trunk.
- Map 3: Serpent Mound, a point of interest just southwest of Van Horn. Look in the hole in the snake's head.
- Treasure: walk through the Elysian Pool waterfall (northwest of Van Horn) into the hidden cave. Crouch through the low tunnel at the bottom of the slope, go right at the fork (the left path is your way back), and continue to a larger chamber. Turn left and make a running jump down to the platform below, then go down the slope. From the shallow pool, climb into the small alcove on the left: four gold bars are behind the rocks.
- Leave by climbing back up, taking the narrow ledge on the right and the passage above to the fork, then the tunnel out.

topics.title: Graves of fallen companions (spoilers)
topics.text: Spoiler warning: best read after the Epilogue. Nine companions and associates who die during the story have graves around the world. All nine are needed for 100% and the Paying Respects trophy, from Epilogue 1 at the earliest. The guide marks their locations on page 346 without naming them; on this site they're numbered map markers (Grave 1-9).

topics.title: Story postscripts (spoilers)
topics.text:
Spoiler warning.
- Braithwaites' Secret: south of the gazebo where you met Penelope, west of Braithwaite Manor, is a locked outhouse in the woods. Before the end of Chapter 6 its occupant is alive; from Epilogue 1 she's dead.
- Catherine Braithwaite: from Chapter 4, her body is in the burned-out manor (loot an emerald brooch); a lock box a few steps east holds a gold bar. Another letter about both families is in a small chest in the mud at the foot of a large tree on the main islet directly west of Sisika Island.
- Grays' Secret: after A Short Walk in a Pretty Town, a letter on the table by Mr Gray's body behind the manor reveals the family's origins.
- Micah: after Epilogue 2, go back to the top of Mount Hagen for his frozen body and revolver (needed for all weapons).
- Micah's camp (northeast of Strawberry, used between Blessed are the Meek? and An American Pastoral Scene): a wanted poster of Dutch and newspaper scraps about Micah's past and the Blackwater job.

topics.title: The Strange Statues puzzle
topics.text:
One of the hardest secrets. Try it with as little help as possible; the steps below go from hint to solution.
- Step 1: find a crevice in the granite leading to a cave with seven male statues around a winged woman. Sketch it (Strange Statues). Each pedestal has a button that toggles in and out.
- Step 2: the statues differ by their hands: count each one's unbroken fingers. You get 2, 4, 5, 8, 3, 4, 6.
- Step 3: west along the railroad at Window Rock, a cave painting under the overhang is also called Strange Statues. It shows seven men in a circle around an eagle, and hands everywhere.
- Step 4: count the tail feathers on each man's eagle: 2, 7, 5, 8, 3, 4, 6. One differs: 7 instead of 4.
- Step 5: the statue with a broken arm has 4 fingers on its remaining hand; its missing arm lies on the ground (left of the entrance) with 3 more, making 7.
- Solution: press the buttons on the statues whose finger totals are prime (2, 5, 3, 7) and leave the rest. The central pedestal opens with three gold bars.

topics.title: Curious places and hidden scenes
topics.text:
- Meteor house (cabin west of Brandywine Drop): a grim scene inside and a meteorite that reduces hot-weather effects by 10%. Around 2am, look up from the field to the west for a meteor shower.
- Bottle tree (west of Dewberry Creek, on the hill above Flat Iron Lake): shoot the hanging bottles; the one glinting gold in Eagle Eye drops a gold nugget. A ginseng elixir sits on the tree.
- A strange shack north of the East Grizzlies: tonics, and a pot of odd liquid you can drink at your own risk.
- Derailed train in the ravine just east of Granite Pass: a chest in the yellow carriage, and two gold bars in the vertical carriage (enter from above).
- Farm just west of Emerald Ranch: a dead man and a black sheep with a gold wedding ring in the southernmost of three shacks.
- Shipwreck on the largest island west of Clemens Point: aged pirate rum in a lock box and a tricorn hat. Guarma species like the green iguana live on this island.
- Old campsite among cactuses east of Armadillo: a dead traveler with a letter, loot, and valerian root in a lock box under the tent.
- Many more: whispering trees south of Brandywine Drop; a sundial on the ridge west of Mount Shann; lightning strikes near the top of Rio Del Lobo Rock and west of the road southwest of Annesburg; a stuffed gorilla under a bridge north of Strawberry; a love message on a tree north of Flatneck Station; a giant snake in a tree west of Lagras; a corpse pit east of Aurora Basin; an abandoned camp by the railroad north of Bluewater Marsh; a hearse with a hanged man north of MacFarlane's Ranch; a man in a tree house south of MacFarlane's Ranch; chain gang remains west of the Kamassa River north of Bluewater Marsh.

ranges.note: Ranges are read off the guide's per-species habitat maps (pp. 149-161), lined up with this map, in 4-unit cells (one pixel of the guide's maps); a cell is in a range when at least half of it is red.

species.name: Sage
species.where: Grows in many places; the guide points to both banks of the Kamassa River.

species.name: Burdock Root
species.where: Western Great Plains, along the railway and the riverbanks.

species.name: Ginseng
species.where: Forests and damp places all over the map.

species.name: Creeping Thyme
species.where: Thin soil on riverbanks (also sandy ground and near rocks).

species.name: Currant
species.where: Foothills and streams in West Elizabeth and the northeast of New Hanover.

species.name: Indian Tobacco
species.where: Woods and savannahs in West Elizabeth, Ambarino and Lemoyne.

species.name: Common Bulrush
species.where: Beside streams and lakes all over the map.

species.name: Oleander Sage
species.where: Riverbanks of Bayou Nwa. Poisonous; used to make poison weapons.

species.name: English Mace
species.where: Riverbanks in Rio Bravo, New Austin.

species.name: Prairie Poppy
species.where: The Great Plains, often close to the railway.

species.name: Milkweed
species.where: Riverbanks of Bayou Nwa and along Dewberry Creek.

species.name: Violet Snowdrop
species.where: The north of Ambarino.

species.name: Oregano
species.where: Dry grassland, in many places.

species.name: Wild Mint
species.where: Marshes, streams and damp meadows.

species.name: Vanilla Flower
species.where: Riverbanks of Bayou Nwa.

species.name: Yarrow
species.where: Grassland and open woods in New Hanover and Lemoyne.

species.where: Cholla Springs, New Austin.

species.name: Blackberry

species.name: Parasol Mushroom
species.where: Well-drained soil and woods all over the map.

species.where: Most regions.
